It seems like every election is framed as the most important we've faced.
But with the attacks on our democracy and our fundamental right to vote, especially in the wake of the Supreme Court's decisions that dismantle the Voting Rights Act, the importance of the midterms cannot be understated .
We have no time to waste. Chip in $35 or more right now to defend our fundamental right to vote! >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=043026_4&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Team
The Constitution places the authority to run elections squarely with the states and Congress – NOT with the federal government.
But now, the President has issued another executive order imposing sweeping new federal control over election administration.
Make no mistake, Team, this is yet another unlawful attempt by this MAGA administration to sow confusion and distrust ahead of the fall midterm elections.
We're doing everything in our power to fight back and protect the right to vote , including:
➜ Registering eligible voters
➜ Putting election information directly in the hands of voters
➜ Combating election misinformation
➜ Advocating at every level to keep our elections truly free and fair
Team, it will take massive resources to stand up to this new executive order in time to make a difference before the midterm elections. We need your help ASAP: Will you chip in $35 or whatever you can afford right now? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=043026_4&amount=35]

The executive order purports to address “non-citizen voting.”
States, however, already have proven systems in place to verify voter eligibility, non-citizen voting is already a federal crime, and instances are vanishingly rare.
Rather than solving a real problem, this order manufactures one to justify granting this administration unprecedented authority over a process which the Constitution clearly delegates to the states and to Congress.
It's simple: This executive order is dangerous, unlawful, and harmful to voters.
We will never stay silent when the right to vote is attacked, Team, including by a hostile administration in control of the federal government.
If you’re with us, please chip in $35 or whatever you can to fuel our work empowering voters ahead of the 2026 elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=043026_4&amount=35]

Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

subject: Don’t sit this one out, Peter
body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20260430-2215-foote&t=1001&akid=2215%2E342411%2EiXQoVc ]Squad Victory Fund

Peter,

We’re coming up on our [ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260430-movement.TMWc_Y&refcode=em20260430-2215&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=2215%2E342411%2EiXQoVc ]end-of-month deadline, and this one is about
something we think a lot of people are feeling right now: whether
collective action is still powerful enough to beat what we’re up against.

While most people are trying to pay rent, get to work, and take care of
their families, the people at the top are still pushing the same agenda:
scare immigrants, gut voting rights, and keep power locked up where it
already is.

But we’ve seen what actually happens on the ground.

When people organize together, when neighbors look out for each other,
when movements refuse to let go — that’s when things shift. That’s when
power starts to move in a different direction.

That belief is why each member of the Squad ran for Congress in the first
place. And it’s still the reason they show up every day.

Alexandria, Ayanna, Ilhan and Rashida didn’t come here through the usual
pipeline. They came through organizing, protests, community meetings, and
all the messy, hopeful work of people trying to make things better
together.

And the Squad doesn’t take corporate PAC money. They don’t want their
decisions shaped anywhere but the communities we come from.

The Squad Victory Fund is one way we keep that collective work going — not
as individuals trying to hold on, but as part of a larger movement
building power together. It helps defend our seats and keep the fight for
progressive change strong.

But none of that works if people sit it out. So we’re asking you:

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260430-movement.TMWc_Y&refcode=em20260430-2215&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1003&akid=2215%2E342411%2EiXQoVc ]Will you chip in $3 ahead of tonight’s midnight deadline
to help us keep showing up, standing up, and driving change where it’s
needed most?

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260430-movement.TMWc_Y&refcode=em20260430-2215&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=2215%2E342411%2EiXQoVc ]Contribute ››

Thank you,

Team SVF

name: Team Goldman
subject: The Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dan Goldman for New York**
body:
|
---
We're disgusted, Peter. The Supreme Court’s conservative majority just issued a ruling out of Louisiana that is nothing short of a direct assault on our democracy. By requiring a racial gerrymandering claim to be both “intentional” and “not political,” they have effectively rendered Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act a "dead letter." [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130519161/618030651/-1870630518?refcode=AU_DSG_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20260430_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMjJjNGU1ZC1mNTQ0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xGTa124fowVYCLzdxTlncL4bmEs-1b4MiJi8eJ72vzc=) Let’s be clear about what is happening: This radical, MAGA-aligned Court is providing a roadmap for Republican-led states to systematically redraw districts to exclude minorities from any representation of their communities. This decision erases decades of progress, allows GOP racial gerrymandering, and undermines the crucial role the Voting Rights Act has played in protecting Black and brown communities from voter suppression. **This is nothing less than a coordinated effort to ensure Republicans can maintain power by choosing their voters, rather than letting voters choose their representatives.** From hand-picked justices who misled the Senate under oath to this latest attack on the centerpiece of the Civil Rights Movement, the legitimacy of this Court is in tatters. name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Before you log off
body:
I want to share something with you before you log off for the night
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Hi Peter, before you log off for the night, I want to share something with you.
But first: [**will you pitch in any amount to my campaign before our end-of-month fundraising deadline at midnight?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20260430_3_final.CJXa7J&refcode=em20260430-1032&t=1&akid=1032%2E299639%2EmpHYFV)
I _never_ set out to run for office.
But in 2012, when my son’s neighborhood school was in danger of closing, I had to do something about it. I couldn’t just sit back and watch it happen. So I ran for the Austin school board to stop it.
That first race taught me something I’ve never forgotten. You can’t underestimate what ordinary people can do when they decide to fight for something that matters.
And that is the exact spirit I’m bringing into this campaign for Governor.
We have six months until Election Day. Six months to show up across Texas, listen in every corner of this state, and build the kind of campaign that earns trust and delivers real change. But that requires resources.
Tonight, we have an important monthly fundraising deadline.
We’re incredibly close to hitting our April goal. My team ran the numbers, and if you and just a few more supporters chip in before midnight, I know we can get there.
**So, if you can spare even a couple of dollars tonight, I’d be truly grateful:[secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_gh_20260430_3_final](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20260430_3_final.CJXa7J&refcode=em20260430-1032&t=2&akid=1032%2E299639%2EmpHYFV)**
Thank you for being part of this campaign, Peter.
Gina

Not only are Trump’s approval ratings plummeting, but strong progressives are being elected all across the country. ** _But the work doesn’t stop there._ If you want to see a Congress with the courage to stand up to the insurance industry, the fossil fuel industry, big tech, and the oligarchs who control the political and economic life of our nation – we have to work together. [**_That’s why I am reaching out to you today. The Congressional Progressive Caucus PAC is dedicated to electing progressive leaders across the country and they need your support. | Patriot,
---
I'm not writing you this letter from _Congressman_ Jim Jordan.
---
Instead, I'm writing to you just as _Jim_ - husband, father of 4, and sports fan.
---
So, as a fellow patriot like you who loves our country, I say this with a heavy heart...
---
... _A far-Left Democrat Governor just RIGGED the congressional map in Virginia, likely costing Republicans 4 SEATS in the House_.
---
In response, some have turned to despair: _" It's all over." "We're doomed." "We're powerless."_
---
Some have even blamed top activists like you for the loss for not giving an extra donation on a random Tuesday. _They are just shameful for saying that ... _
---
Let's be honest. That's _not_ the American spirit.
---
**Does that doom and gloom sound like President Trump when he was targeted ...wrongfully ARRESTED FOUR TIMES...and still kept fighting?**
---
Here's the truth: _I don 't care if the polling says we're down 99 points and a storm is brewing, you will _NEVER_ hear the word "SURRENDER" come out of my mouth._
---
That's a promise.
---
And I've put skin in the game to prove it... I've been _SUED_ _and_ _SPIED_ on by the Deep State - and all because they know I fight for YOU.
---
**Now comes our most important fight. We can 't let the Democrats get away with rigging the congressional map.**
---
Emergency mid-decade redistricting battles are now taking place all across America - and with ZERO margin for error, we need to know exactly who will show up to vote.
---
That means our Trump Voter Census has to be 100% complete and 100% accurate - and I know with absolute confidence that the President and I can count on you. _Now let 's make it official._

| | | **This[Arab American Heritage Month](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130519861/618047305/-844499796?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzUvMS84MDk5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ODA1YzcxMy1mOTQ0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=g7Wto3n-29DQEg7F2k1HHNarwdyMXsCsx8PEc3ukQbk=&emci=90d31f02-1744-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=9805c713-f944-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=560478), we honor the rich culture and history of Arab Americans who have helped move our Party, state and nation forward.**

California is home to the largest and most diverse population of Arab Americans in the nation, and our state’s history has long been shaped by this community–from elected leaders and labor rights leaders to entrepreneurs, artists and scientists. In 2022, [Little Arabia](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130519866/618047307/-146430845?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzUvMS84MDk5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ODA1YzcxMy1mOTQ0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=g7Wto3n-29DQEg7F2k1HHNarwdyMXsCsx8PEc3ukQbk=&emci=90d31f02-1744-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=9805c713-f944-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=560478) in Anaheim, California was designated the [first Arab-American cultural district in the nation](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130519872/618047313/2095804567?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzUvMS84MDk5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ODA1YzcxMy1mOTQ0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=g7Wto3n-29DQEg7F2k1HHNarwdyMXsCsx8PEc3ukQbk=&emci=90d31f02-1744-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=9805c713-f944-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=560478)–only made possible by decades of organizing by hundreds of activists, business owners and residents who fought to be seen and represented.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130519875/618047319/2095804567?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA%3D%3D&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzUvMS84MDk5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ODA1YzcxMy1mOTQ0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=g7Wto3n-29DQEg7F2k1HHNarwdyMXsCsx8PEc3ukQbk=&emci=90d31f02-1744-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=9805c713-f944-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=560478)

California also passed the [MENA Inclusion Act](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130519878/618047322/-1324542103?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzUvMS84MDk5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ODA1YzcxMy1mOTQ0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=g7Wto3n-29DQEg7F2k1HHNarwdyMXsCsx8PEc3ukQbk=&emci=90d31f02-1744-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=9805c713-f944-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=560478), ensuring that Middle Eastern and North African (MENA) communities are counted and represented in data collection that informs policy decisions on health care, education, civil rights and access to essential public services. That effort was led by a statewide coalition of more than a dozen grassroots, MENA-led, MENA-serving and MENA-founded organizations fighting to advance the rights and visibility of MENA Californians. Made up of over 20 nationalities and numerous religious groups, the Arab American community is rich in history and diverse in culture, and reaffirms what we know to be true here in California: Our diversity is what makes us great. Arab Americans have enriched communities across California and the country, and we are proud to celebrate their invaluable contributions to our shared history this month and always.

In 2022, in Anaheim, California was designated the –only made possible by decades of organizing by hundreds of activists, business owners and residents who fought to be seen and represented. California also passed the , ensuring that Middle Eastern and North African (MENA) communities are counted and represented in data collection that informs policy decisions on health care, education, civil rights and access to essential public services. That effort was led by a statewide coalition of more than a dozen grassroots, MENA-led, MENA-serving and MENA-founded organizations fighting to advance the rights and visibility of MENA Californians. Made up of over 20 nationalities and numerous religious groups, the Arab American community is rich in history and diverse in culture, and reaffirms what we know to be true here in California: Our diversity is what makes us great. [1]Justice Democrats

We’ll be brutally honest, Peter:

Our grassroots fundraising has significantly slowed. Just take a look for
yourself:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260430-2.9ODRYI&refcode=em20260430-37731&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=37731%2E1203867%2ErNb3uO ]Bar chart showing values going down from January through April 2026.

April is coming to a close in just a few hours, and unfortunately, we’ve
only raised less than half as much as we did in March from one-time
donations.

That’s not good, especially as we head into the next four months of
Democratic primary elections, starting with Chris Rabb’s race in
Pennsylvania on May 19.

We came out swinging in the 2026 election cycle, endorsing 15 progressive
candidates running in open House seats or challenging out-of-touch
Democratic incumbents. So far, we’ve lost three of these races and won
one.

There are eleven more primaries to go, giving us the opportunity to send a
dozen Justice Democrats to join our Squad in Congress and fight for the
working-class.

But since we don’t take any corporate contributions, we depend directly on
grassroots contributions from folks like you to fuel our candidates and
fight back against AIPAC, billionaires, and corporate super PACs.

This year’s midterms are a major opportunity for our people-powered

Thank you for anything you can chip in to fuel our work and transform the
Party.

— Justice Democrats

_What if_ I told you that Democratic governors are now a critical firewall at times when the federal government abuses its power and undermines civil liberties?
_What if_ I told you that I'm the only candidate in this race with a plan to shield Coloradans from Donald Trump's retaliation _and_ tackle the affordability crisis squeezing folks across our state – from increasing the supply of _real_ starter homes, to lowering health care costs by launching a public option, to expanding affordable child care options and _ so much more?_
_What if_ I told you my top GOP opponent is promising to free Trump's convicted Big Lie ally, Tina Peters, on Day One as governor – and that he's already raised more than **$2 MILLION** since the start of this year?
_What if_ I told you that national Republicans are already watching to see if we have the grassroots support to withstand their dark money-funded attack ads?

subject: Catching up
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
| I’m fighting for Wisconsin, and for our country.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=5397%2E35263%2EQTQ6OT)
Peter, In just a moment, I’m going to ask you to [**make a donation toward my April fundraising goal**](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/5473?t=4&akid=5397%2E35263%2EQTQ6OT). But before I do, I want to give you a recap of what I’ve been working on this month. It’s been a busy month of defending Wisconsin’s best interests in the Senate. Trump’s reckless war in Iran — and the pain it’s causing here at home — took center stage. This illegal war is costing over a billion dollars a _day_ by most estimates, and Donald Trump has no plan for ending it. I led a war powers resolution that came to the Senate floor last week. It failed, but I will keep working to get Republican senators to stand up and use their authority. Meanwhile, I’m continuing to hold the USPS accountable to millions of Wisconsinites who rely on its services, pressing Postmaster General David Steiner for answers as to why it is taking weeks for mail to be delivered to some Wisconsin communities. Millions of Wisconsinites rely on the Postal Service to stay in touch with loved ones, pay bills, receive much-needed medications, and cast their votes. We have a duty to find solutions to these difficulties for the people we serve. Likewise, we have a duty to those who have served this nation. The administration announced its plans to overhaul the VA, and I’ve demanded that Veteran Affairs Secretary Doug Collins provide details about these plans and their impact on veterans’ services. Local communities need to know that access to care will not be compromised through the pursuit of administrative efficiency. Finally, I’m working to make sure all Packers fans can tune in to the game. I’ve introduced a bill to make it cheaper for people to watch their favorite teams by prohibiting league-owned streaming services, such as MLB.TV or NBA League Pass, from blacking out games and by requiring the leagues to provide a way for local fans to watch their home-state teams. **I’m fighting to deliver for working families in Wisconsin and to elect Democrats up and down the ballot in Wisconsin.** [**So if you can, please consider pitching in a grassroots donation to fuel my work before our monthly deadline tonight. Every dollar brings us closer to more wins, more progress, and a brighter future for Wisconsin and our country.**](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/5473?t=5&akid=5397%2E35263%2EQTQ6OT) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [EXPRESS DONATE $5](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/3663?c0=stb-em-apr26.0nKLzm&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20260430_PM1_V1_S1&t=6&akid=5397%2E35263%2EQTQ6OT)

body:
Making hard choices
| I didn’t make this decision lightly. When I announced my campaign for governor of Wisconsin, I did it because I saw how much our working families were struggling – and what would be at stake if a Republican was elected to lead this state. _Healthcare costs are skyrocketing because Tom Tiffany voted against extending subsidies._ _Our family farms and small businesses are feeling the squeeze due to the Trump-Tiffany economic plan._ _And when Republicans care more about lining the pockets of their billionaire backers, working families lose out on affordable housing and groceries._ **I’m in this race for the same reason I first began public service — because Wisconsinites deserve a state where they can thrive, not just scrape by paycheck to paycheck.[In a few hours, we’re closing the books on our April fundraising. If you agree with me, you can use this link to make a contribution of any amount to power our campaign.](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mb-em-fr-apr26.K8_u48&amount=15&refcode=MB_EM_FR_043026_B3_EOM&t=2&akid=6113%2E196590%2E3kzkj5)** **Tiffany will bring the rampant dysfunction and far-right extremism of Washington here to Wisconsin.** Thanks to grassroots supporters like you, we’ve built a movement that is ready to do things the Wisconsin Way, not the Washington Way. name: Wiener, Scott
subject: This is my last email
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott WIENER FOR CONGRESS
body:
| | Peter,

This is my last email before our April deadline.

Next week, ballots start arriving in San Francisco. Every day will become election day. And what we’ve built by midnight tonight will determine how we fight it.

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=9773%2E5257348%2ECTK_Cv ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Hi Derek, I know
you hear from a lot of folks, so I have a personal request:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/6445?t=1004&akid=9773%2E5257348%2ECTK_Cv ]Will you chip in a few dollars to support my work in the Senate?

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q22026_abs_em.dQeZoR&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20260430_PM2_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=9773%2E5257348%2ECTK_Cv ]PITCH IN NOW

My top priority is to make a real difference for the working people in our
country who are facing higher costs at the grocery store, on their rent,
and at the gas pump. Not to mention their healthcare.

Those aren’t just empty words. Fighting to make the economy work for
people again is why I get up in the morning, and why you sent me to the
Senate.

I’m hearing from countless families worried about making ends meet in a
dire economic situation. And I’m doing something about it — working to
bring down energy costs, to lower the price of healthcare, to stop Trump’s
illegal tariffs, and to build more housing.

Donald Trump and Senate Republicans are making this work much more
difficult. Every day, there’s a new update on how they’re cutting jobs,
slashing healthcare and food assistance, and disrupting the crucial work
to help hard-working families just get by. And Trump’s Iran war is making
us all pay more for gas, groceries, and more.

It’s immoral and unjust. And it doesn’t have to be this way.

And while they destroy our economy and get us involved in stupid wars with
no authorization, they distract us with chaos and nonsense on Fox News —
including personal attacks against me from Donald Trump and Tulsi Gabbard.

Here’s what you need to know: Trump will try to distract us with his lies
and smears. But that can’t stop us from holding him and his cronies
accountable and making sure voters know the real consequences of their
destructive agenda.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/6445?t=1006&akid=9773%2E5257348%2ECTK_Cv ]Your support helps me deliver and hold the GOP to account for their
actions. So please, chip in a few dollars to help me get the job done. I

body:
Dear Peter,
At midnight tonight, we reach the end of April. With just over a month until the primary election, what we raise now could make all the difference.
I’ll explain more about how we’ll put your resources to work for this campaign, but if you’re with me, use this link to chip in before midnight: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_kp_20260430_3_ak?refcode=em20260430-41245](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260430_3_ak.J8s5UG&refcode=em20260430-41245&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=41245%2E3422442%2EqwL7k_)**
In these final weeks, our campaign is going all out to reach voters across California. We launched our **Whiteboard Warriors Tour** to meet working people and share how I’m going to fight for them as governor.

subject: We're still shaking

body:
On Saturday night, a California man armed with a shotgun, a handgun, and multiple knives charged the security checkpoint at the White House Correspondents’ Dinner, with President Trump in the room.

|
---
| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zk14e8t2l264bp0nqk6bp4mjoto7vfc28qk53o20_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cdj66o72clh2bs) Friend,

On Saturday night, a California man armed with a shotgun, a handgun, and multiple knives charged the security checkpoint at the White House Correspondents’ Dinner, with President Trump in the room.

His name is Cole Allen, a 31-year-old tutor from Torrance, California.

And before he made his move, he sent a manifesto to his own family laying out exactly what he intended to do.

**He wanted to target administration officials, starting with the President of the United States!**

Let us be clear about what just happened...

**This is the _third time_ they have tried to kill President Trump.**

And this time, the man who pulled the trigger wasn’t some lone lunatic who slipped through the cracks. He had a plan, a manifesto, multiple weapons, and a hotel room on the 10th floor of the venue. He ran into that building while the President of the United States was inside!

The radical left has spent years calling President Trump every name in the book. Calling his supporters terrorists. Weaponizing the courts, the FBI, and every arm of the federal government to destroy him. Calling for resistance by any means necessary.

Well. Here is the truth:

**The Left is not going to stop. They will not accept the results of free and fair elections. They will not stop at legal warfare. Now we have seen – again – what happens when they incite enough hatred.**

This is exactly why what Turning Point PAC is doing matters so much right now.

**We are not fighting a political campaign. We are fighting for the survival of this movement.**

We are fighting to make sure that the America First movement cannot be stopped by violence, lawfare, or any other means the radical left throws at it.
[Fight for the America First Movement](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7q49gji3lqv5dg0pqo24grqmof5ll3afg55il38_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cdj66o72clh2bs)
**Here is how you can help right now:**

**ONE:** Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire are the battleground states where 2026 – and the road to 2028 – will be decided. The radical left is already pouring millions into these states.

**TWO:** Turning Point PAC is hiring, training, and funding **700 NEW ballot chasers**. Boots on the ground. Real relationships in real communities. Not TV ads. Not consultants. People.

**THREE:** Republicans outnumber Democrats in registration in these key states. We have the voters. We just need to reach them – and _**we need your help to do it**_.

Every **$50** you give funds a ballot chaser for a full day in the field.

[Every dollar you contribute today is a direct response to what happened Saturday night.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdthk04lntcjjulqm04pk2kiubrc7kijjvne0u8o_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cdj66o72clh2bs)

It is a statement that this movement will not be intimidated. That we will not be silenced. That _**we will not back down**_.

**Please stand with Turning Point PAC right now.**
[$50 – Fund a Ballot Chaser for a Day](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5h7u6nt1qgd4f7mo61jpqer1s2glctt5grnb7ho_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cdj66o72clh2bs)

[$100 – Sponsor 2 Ballot Chasers](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zca1uat59iq2gpukscac7d1vhvvropmr2aomq2eg_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cdj66o72clh2bs)

[$250 – 5 Days of Boots On the Ground](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z05l75a2nmvq1ci97fp3btj89d8633vlrncolog8_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cdj66o72clh2bs)

[$500 – 10 Days of Boots On the Ground](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4msbdoollfaor3vc5uscoq8ukcejhf9vqpflup8_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cdj66o72clh2bs)

[Donate Any Other Amount](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlfe9gdu01hj3bca4ptfjp6836ratrp9qflgsoi8_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cdj66o72clh2bs)
They tried to stop him with two bullets in Butler, Pennsylvania.

They tried to stop him with a gunman on a golf course.

They tried to stop him on Saturday night with a shotgun, a handgun, and a manifesto.

**And every single time, he survived. And every single time, the America First movement came back stronger.**

That’s because of you. And it’s because of what we are building together.

The Red Wall starts in 2026. Help us build it.

For America and for Charlie,

Tyler Bowyer
Executive Director

Peter, This is wild.
After the Supreme Court cleared the path for a return to Jim Crow-era voter suppression, MAGA Republicans are moving aggressively to eliminate Black and minority representatives up and down the ballot.
Louisiana Governor Jeff Landry just cancelled a primary election scheduled in two weeks so MAGA lawmakers can redraw the state's maps.
Early voting and absentee voting was scheduled to start Saturday and thousands of voters have already received their ballots, but they don't care. They want power at any cost.
Now the most ineffective Speaker of the House in U.S. history, Mike Johnson (R-LA), is calling for other states to do what his home state of Louisiana is doing: cancel elections to rig the maps even more for the GOP.
---
| [](https://r6msg8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001qYx0hDG_Hfsh3PayGCZXOXMLbjGZtDbcxUnjSDgOrMgg2k3FuwWps9ETE2ntrtqhKYgqWCxiyHnl5CIvWpQ5I9XMha6kQDqfo053ssN4fOjrLuzj0Tv3mj4WypQI6DkpbPg806zRtZ3dn5vL5y9v_fwxx_y1wdc8U-d1wZx3W-8r-0Qd9-eHCgben81912MX6N6tcSS0phlow9Hz2nnQsi_qUIy9Z2jw&c=Iw-DubqKjAADIi1MMlw1x7aEd-IYrEEnfxuONfz_j-khYbAjUEYMyA==&ch=fi_LwxyGDKyry6tWo2auOh5QpxONWO5Na1IT86zJsHWzqNX0RNrV8Q==)

We absolutely can fight this, and we are working around the clock to make sure voters see MAGA's corruption, voter suppression, and anti-democratic power grab.
But what we can't do is fight back alone. MAGA is relying on Democrats throwing our hands up, saying all is lost, and remaining scattered, divided, and scared.
We aren't doing that. Not this time. I've seen enough in my lifetime to know that folks will only rally to a cause if they think the people behind it have passion, courage, and grit.
I am a third generation farmer, and the grandson of a sharecropper who toiled in the very fields that my son and I now own. I'm proud to lead the fight against MAGA as they try to drag us back to Jim Crow. We aren't going back.
[This is the fight of our lives. Will you stand with me and with Democrats in Louisiana who are putting EVERYTHING on the line to fight back and punish MAGA this November? ## Trump Signs Bill, Ends DHS Shutdown
President Trump on Thursday [signed legislation](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDkO2zAURE8jdRS4aLEKFmnUOW1KgSE_qR9wEchvK759IF8h7QwwmPd-PfenwYg5_DQJNPmyZ7haBCKouy05VGgNsmvteJErVyZT0e-Sy5nxiXGxO4Pxs4-90x5AgupBi2VZZrmuYu0P_Vs-1snNdlxno9S4jOAfQs4Pp4QFz1WP-l7jExeC80nMw2SXRU1GSlBWCq-6kYNDKnX4UzDTAT5-yhvqYEvqoz6IztapH53cOrld1zX48vemuPtObmeJSGhbJzeqr3SyG4e5o7FYcmDZEJZsIssYDkqmAsOUMNRvziD7Ui0kyMQaYYwsgid2mBwwh75qd14YI7Z56UYeksH4_UX_JfOt5b8AAAD__5FKjP8) ending the longest partial government shutdown in U.S. history at 75 days, hours after the House agreed by voice vote to fund most of the Department of Homeland Security. clean_body: The House to fund most of the Department of Homeland Security, ending the longest partial government shutdown in U.S. history at 76 days. | | | | | | Friday, May 1, 2026 ---|--- Good Morning! On this day in 1931, President Herbert Hoover symbolically dedicated New York City's by pressing a button from the White House to turn on its lights, though someone else flipped the switches in New York. One year ago, we hit "record" on something new, and it's grown into something incredible. Today, The Flyover Podcast reaches more than 1.4 million listeners each month, delivering clear, direct, and unbiased coverage of the stories that matter most. What started as a simple idea is now part of daily routines across the country, and we couldn't have done it without you. As we head into year two, we're excited to bring you new content, new formats, and new ways to stay informed. We're just getting started. Tune in to today's Podcast Extra stories, featuring a new form of "genetic cholesterol" that could become the next big breakthrough in preventing heart attacks. . Temperatures are starting to climb, and it doesn't take much to feel the difference. Warmer days, more time outside, and suddenly hydration matters a lot more. , has become something we reach for regularly this time of year. | Trump Signs Bill, Ends DHS Shutdown President Trump on Thursday ending the longest partial government shutdown in U.S. history at 75 days, hours after the House agreed by voice vote to fund most of the Department of Homeland Security. The bill reopens DHS components, including the TSA, Coast Guard, FEMA, and Secret Service, through Sept. 30. DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin had warned by Friday, putting paychecks at risk for tens of thousands of workers. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

## Paxton Targets Houston 'Birth Tourism' Center
Attorney General Ken Paxton has filed a lawsuit against De'Ai Postpartum Care Center, a Houston-area business [accused](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O5CAQRk-DM1qAsbEDgk2c9aYbWtWmbFhhaEG5f24_cs_cYMJSSU_fe_-u8xVCDGn7Cztaeq15TvisEYmwzHd4UU4EZUOqt1DIUz5KqPushOq56LiQs4MQ37NunL0JN8oGrTTG9G2re9l4OwyrkgOuozNdpzqtAJ1sOxjWYWyX29gEe8JEJ6SUQitxAVjF4IxejQZhnGBaoAuUy4U8Er6grvGdH1guS96baD3RvbL2D1MTU9P_oxJ5PC3OP1NTAgo5MTVVAsLK1PTtxeuBlft81PNYoCBfMBEWfsI5xIgbOr74kLAi__jznwC8Lh53bIp192eIMdTeMC22HUL8zKLfxXxY9RUAAP__qiGN1w) of operating a network of "birth tourism" facilities. The business has allegedly [facilitated](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb8GOtB4bOykcLENXbbdEg3YYEsmjuxJSP5-Rd4nvG5GVzpX5_67TTeKKd63v7R7y-81T3d_1OSZfZke9OZ8Zyqb5zrHwoHzs8S6TwioOxg6EJOjmD6Tap2dwV1F660wxmgplRZtsBcSSrkVaR6Wy-xoRcQFZ9DXAeQiZRvtCYMBhBCgEHqiFS7OqNUoAuOgUeBd5Fx6Dp79m-qaPvnlS7_kvU02MD9qI_80ODY4HsfRfyjkfKYNjqdOgyMVjkvy5_lFdLR1P3pdffrahfys54MChdSoTR94T22x7nHElGLVplGw7RTTt5Z_N9bL4v8AAAD__6-if4Q) the births of more than 1,000 children in nearly two decades by providing housing and travel assistance to foreign nationals. According to the lawsuit, it has [advertised](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGyqyAQxvGn0Q4HECUWFLexy21v6ayyKDMIGVijefs7yckbnP4_O_v7_t2nO_jg4_oXdjR0uTRFPEtAIszTAy5KkSCvSGX2mTZKR_ZlnySXPeMd42Ky4MNrUrU1M7eDqNEIrXXftqoX9WY6oVTb8_nmBtkhdoNzLQgNMAAX1tnam_cx3nEhBFeSNwCO36xWTivg2vJKcbSeUm5oQ8ILiguv9MTcLGmvg9mIHqVq_1RyrOR4nmfj0iX7LR2FUnxHlRzfqkqOPyIGy3IULOzbMMgIbD6Kj1gKy0eMPq7sI2ZfMivLhjvW2djH6UPwpdeV4usOPnweod_N9zTyfwAAAP__TXOJAw) its services on Chinese social media platforms. _" America is for Americans, not foreigners trying to cheat the system to claim citizenship,"_ [said Paxton](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb8GOiPbGJwULrZJ97bdEk3wACMZG9mTQPbrV-Rlv-B1M5qj0b3nz9fwBRQozr9hRcfHlIaIewnIjHnY4OAUGfKMXO6UeeH0yFTWQUvdC9kJqQYPFF6Dqb27S39VNTplre3b1vSqXtzV6rb3vvXXroNLd2nVFbXR7eWuR48GanLnM9lJpZQ0WjYAk7x4ayZrQFovKyPRE6fc8IKMB5QpvNITczOmtQ5uYd5K1f6q9K3St33fmzcEzClHfM0YMUNo5vSs9O1sV-lbxoBQ8Bz_c-IDiu_WojywiCU9yrlARhBvA-KjQIwYGbPAYwuJmOL8fc80LyxGYvqLsSy01dn5bacQqPS2MnJegcI7Ov9M-NPpfwEAAP__TQycpw). _" Birthright citizenship is a scam that threatens national security, and I will do everything in my power to stop unlawful 'birth tourism' schemes like this one."_ The Center is accused of violating multiple laws, including the Texas Deceptive Trade Practices Act. The lawsuit aims to shut down the business and [impose fines](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHSoyAQgJ8GOxxAIr8FxTV0ufZKZ4VVmaBkYBOTt78xlze4boudb_f7_lzHK8QU9-U3bGjpNedxx6MmJMIy3uFFeScoC1KdYqGV8qPEuo1KqJ6LCxdyDBDTe9RNsJMIg2zQSmNM33W6l81qL4M0XvluMnM3zD9qMqY3wWszGQlosIn2hImLkFIKrUQLMIufYPRsNAgTBNMCQ6RcWlqR8AV1Tu_8xNL6vDXJrkT3yrpfTDmm3HEcrU_R39SaH5Xyfm4x5U4tplzKHhJT7rzJlBP6nAem3AfMYeE33Pk_cT7HhJUnOOojEocF4l6Jf7n8E4R_i3CPO2FhyjXFhvsRU4q1N0yLZYOYPq_S_wV-WvU3AAD__8qmkcc) of more than $1 million. Meanwhile, Paxton has also [expanded](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOozAQBOCngQ7ktY2XFC6uocu1V6IFL8GSgZy9Ccnb_0pe4e-_mZHm33W8Ukxxv_2ljb28lmPc-SyJRTiPd3rJsQvlG0uZYpZVjkeOZRu10q5RXaNgDBTTe7R18JMKF6jZAyI6Y6yDevULd72duQO4XAAm1Ki1Xow1qA0uDuvoP2WqUwCgrFYt0aL6gHZBSwqDqqziEOXIraws_KKypPfx5NzOx1Ynv4rcS2X-VHqo9HCe58fNvAvn8v9BmT-u0sM3WumBssQ58eimyZkeumZGcI3lnhpCmBurwNoZKBhn2lW2VGcf7mdMKRaHlVW3jWL6jsvvLnt6_RMAAP__t39-cA) an ongoing investigation into Texas businesses accused of fraudulently exploiting the H-1B visa program.
## Austin Officials Discuss Self-Driving Vehicles
Austin first responders shared their concerns about self-driving vehicles during a special city meeting Wednesday. Waymo, the Google affiliate whose autonomous vehicles have been involved in numerous recent safety incidents, [declined](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOtCAUBeCn0Q4DyIh_QfE3drPtluYKFyVBmMCd0Xn7jbOPsO3Nl5tzzvd9vkOIIa1fsKOh0-c54VEjEmGZH3BSTgRlRapLKLRRfpZQ91lyOTB-Y1zMDkJ8z6p1ZuHun2jRCK310PdqEO1mFmu1671V0vpRLmOPorcLaDvCbRwUb4O5nvEbF0JwJXkH4PnotPJaAdeON4qjC5RLRxsSnlB9fOcXls7mvY1mI3rUpv_fyKmR03Ecnc-nhmelkC7SyOnq1Mjp98YG2lilgkisbjlTSCs74L1nlr0PNkCs7AgxspSJAREmx3bEjwPnCtbKbE4WS6ptMe5x4VAH3Si-7hDiJxj9bc6XkT8BAAD__4NMjzk) to participate in the meeting. One of Waymo's vehicles briefly [blocked](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2u2zAQBODTSB2NJUWJccEijbqXNqWwNlfiApQocPf55_aBkyOk_oDBzPz-Wr6QCx_bL9wp6muty0FPKaRKbTnxpfVQbBup3Lhp1vrdWPbFgZsMjAbskpDLe_F9ijdIV9tTtCGEaRj8ZPscB5oGT1fwwd3HafQe_TTY2zDCel3B-p7jJwxGsNaCd3BBXOFHCn4NHiEk6DxQYq3topmUXihredcHtcu97n2JWfWUbvjZublz8_0m-C3Kx0c7N3_mdG4u9Y6lc_M_M4UwURPT6MH0NI3krIeQybzlwltWw_vZ6oN2OlQMrkrNCL80G9FGpGZHESO5VuVj61tM55NLYZlC52Hbkcvfevp_pz6i-xMAAP__QzeQaw) an ambulance responding to the March 1 mass shooting at a downtown bar. Since then, the company has implemented a "geofence" of at least 1,000 feet around active emergency scenes. Still, first responders indicated they want more collaboration with Waymo. _" We'll do these scenarios that way we can help you kind of work through that, and they have yet to take us up on that,"_ Austin Fire Battalion Chief Matt Holmes [said](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGupDAQRE8DmUdt48H8wMEmZH_TDZHBbWjJ2MjuAeb2q9k9wk9LpVK99-d7-nYUKa2_3Y6W75CnhFeNyIxlOtzNObErK3KdqfDG-VWo7pMC1Qt4CpCTdxTfk269ncF_yRatNMb0Xad72W5WSun7WZouqGGYn-5rMSC97nsIcyeHpSX7GYMnSClBK3g4F2DwRgejHRgPjQb0xLk8eEPG29UQ3_nE8ljy3ka7MR-16X41amzUeF3XI-TbuFdlSp9Ko8YPU6PG_5kIVCqLgvXIyWOpojiqKJacFiypCjfnF4uKMQhf6KS0ihM3WiLWtlh_XBQj1d40GtbdUfz3g39m77TqbwAAAP__JamIAA). City officials are asking state lawmakers to pass legislation that restricts autonomous vehicle operations in the vicinity of serious crashes and allows police officers to issue digital tickets to self-driving vehicles more quickly. Despite at least 236 complaints about traffic violations, Austin police [issued](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykz7FugzAQgOGnMVvQ2RiODB66sKVrR8vE52DV4Mi-Ann7Kn2Fzr_0Sf_Xzd5cTHF7fLqVDJ8h242OmoiZin26k_PGrjyI6xwLL5x_SqyrVaCGC_QXkNa7mF5WN97M4K-yISMRceg6PchmMZ3qvO_HgBJnvI_j2M9SB-2pu2N_ldhE88agByklaAWtcwFGjzqgdoAehAbykXNpeSGm09WQXnmn0t7z2iSzMD-r6D6EmoSajuNov0-3vaNQky9xp5KoVqGmphj_PGJKsQ4oNDxWF9Ofwv973436DQAA___ONm5c) just nine citations against Waymo since the company started operating in 2024.
## Texas Roosters Tied to Global Cockfighting Industry
Korean Air has [suspended](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQAL8GOiPbEBwKF9fQ5dor0WIveBVjI3svJH9_uvzC66YajebPY3kARUr7bzjQ8nvLS8KrRmTGspzw5pwYyo5cVyocOP8tVI9FSz0KeRNSLR4ofpah9XaVflItWmWMGft-GFUbrJ7M3evJjW7F-6RN79dJKjTQA4C7QUv2v0zepFJKDlp2AJu8ezNsZgBpvGwGiZ44l44DMr6hbvGTX1g6l4822sB81qb_1ei50fN1XR1gyUwHfqHRMxQmF7E2en7mgpAEUBEBIldRcq6MRdRA54GJq-AszkCRzpMSVgEHeeGye260B6a0C1fAPX2-UlusPy-KkepomkHuB1D8VvHPXr6s_hcAAP__yiCOTg) rooster shipments from the United States to the Philippines after an investigation exposed how chickens sold by a Texas broker would be used to supply the Asian country's $13 billion cockfighting industry. But this didn't happen by chance.
In 2025, Defend Our Courts built a full-scale electoral program targeting 750,000 low-propensity Democratic voters. We doubled turnout from 30% to 60%--driving hundreds of thousands of additional votes in a judicial election most people ignore.
Those voters didn't just retain Supreme Court Justices Donohue, Dougherty, and Wecht.They also helped retain Judge Wojcik and elect Judge Stella Tsai to the Commonwealth Court.
Those are the judges who made that ruling possible. That's your impact.
And when opponents appeal this decision to the Pennsylvania Supreme Court, as they will, the pro-rights majority you helped protect will be there to uphold it.
But we don't get to stop here. Because while Pennsylvania women are gaining rights-- Women in Georgia are still losing them.

| | | 🚒 I was the Wing Commander of Joint Base Andrews at the time of the F-16 crash in Clinton, Maryland (April 5, 2017), and the collaborative response was incredible. It’s important to remember that:

✅ You can’t surge trust (you need to carefully develop it over time).

✅ You must proactively and intentionally develop a collaborative relationship with entities all around you (it makes things much better in the good times, and it is a necessity in the bad times).

🦀 A huge thanks to the first responders and community partners in Prince George’s County and the great state of Maryland that made this a textbook example of a seamless collaborative response.
---
|
---
💪 Proof I made it to the gym this week!

🇺🇲 🇮🇷 As things MAY be winding down with the war in Iran, the pace of media interviews should soon go back to sustainable steady state as well.

✈️ It has been a wonderful reminder about the need for self-care to sustain the ability to maintain effectiveness. Some call it “putting your mask on first” from the flight attendant spiel – if you don’t, then you quickly become no good to yourself and everyone else around you. Actually, you become a liability❗

🤖 We are NOT robots!

😴 🥙 🏋♀️ ⛪ Don’t forget to put your mask on first for mission effectiveness and long term well-being.

🤣 And when I sent this pic to my family text chain with: “I did 12 hits today, and still made it to the gym”, one of my kids said “I’m confused, you go to Planet Fitness?” You can probably guess who it was – IYKYK! 🤦
|
---
🇮🇷 A national security imperative for the CLARITY Act!

🇺🇲 The CLARITY Act passed the House with bipartisan support (294/134). Now it’s time for the Senate to pass it as well, but not before closing gaps in the current legislation that would allow Iran to sail through it!

💸 Properly crafted legislation must stop the harmful financial tactics that are being exploited by malign actors using digital currency. A well-crafted CLARITY will slam the door shut on terrorists and rogue regimes who are currently avoiding sanctions and fueling illicit activities.

🛳️ The flaunting of our regulatory blind spots by Iran in the Strait of Hormuz provides the compelling tipping point for the Senate to act now! A few important changes to CLARITY will help snuff out the stench of rotten international activity that is profoundly harmful to U.S. interests!
| [ "U.S. Military Can't Afford
Consequences of
Another Rail Merger"](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGSV37CqMDvd0tOpPM2y/TI-jVklfjAl_)
---
🇺🇲 Thanks to Newsmax for publishing these pressing concerns (April 15)!

📣 “When only one railroad controls access to a base or logistics hub, it creates a single point of failure. If something goes wrong — a service disruption or a network slowdown — the military may have few alternatives to move critical equipment. The military plans for redundancy in everything, including communications networks, supply chains, and energy systems. Critical infrastructure should be no different.”
|
---
✂️ Leadership Lesson – who is it about !?️

📣 We had done everything right – prioritizing our base resources to meet an important need: building an indoor playground for the base population. The parents were thrilled. The kids were excited. It was a great example of genuine care and concern for our Airmen and their families at Joint Base Andrews.

🛝 The ribbon cutting was bound to be a success. My team warned me that the scissors weren’t very sharp, and likely wouldn’t cut the ribbon. No worries, they would drop the ends and the kids would rush to be the first ones onto the new playset.

✅ Challenge accepted – I snapped the scissors closed with great zeal and sliced the ribbon in half ...

💥 And that’s when the little girl directly in front of me started crying – the noise of my determined scissor snap scarred her. And I quickly went from a hero to a zero, as her demeanor went from eager excitement to startled terror.

!!️ It provides an important lesson for all leaders. It’s NEVER about you ... not even for a brief moment! We are all wise to remind ourselves of that important truth – again, and again, and again. Trust me, it cuts hard when you forget it!
| [ "America Turns 250"](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGZMVG1nXO576ihZNedE/hmsTZ-tldN3O)

| | | A deep thanks to “Real Clear Politics” for publishing my thoughts in their latest installment of the America Turns 250 series (April 30).
"In 1789, America stood on the brink of history. As the constitutionally based government was forming, the world was watching. After a long-fought battle against the world’s superpower, and a stumbling of government under the Articles of Confederation, could this new experiment work? Much was riding on the outcome, and the important ramifications demanded a leader and an inauguration day that was bathed in reverent humility. We need to rediscover that same spirit in our public life and among our political leaders today." ** _Teichert in the Trenches_**

This is a public service announcement as much as it is a reminder that we all need to power through distractions in our lives.
Before every interview from my home studio, I go through a mental checklist to ensure that I haven’t forgotten something. One of those steps is to set my phone (and computer) to Do Not Disturb.
On this interview for NewsNation (Connell McShane), my phone started ringing through my earpiece. Via side-eyes and look-downs you’ll see me try to figure out what was happening and why?! Did I forgot Do Not Disturb? How do I make it stop? Can they hear it on TV during the interview? What am I supposed to be saying?
I powered through okay, and discovered something important. There are settings in Do Not Disturb that allow people to still call you and the phone to still ring during these times. I recommend you check it out so that you aren’t caught unaware at an inopportune time!

name: Pennsylvania Forward Party
subject: PA FWD Party May Newsletter
body:
Primary month!

|
## Primary Day is May 19!
Pennsylvania has one of the strictest, most restrictive primary systems in the country—completely closed to anyone who's not willing to register as a Republican or a Democrat. Until that system is reformed (by the work of [Ballot PA](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=Mms7B2UdQS1Z2nazLHo9hBfpa1ZPLPkhp5mlASWe-vo&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_newsletter&n=1) and their allies, like us), independent voters are inclined to ignore primary elections. Let's talk about what that means for one candidate we've endorsed.
### 1\. District 196 Special Election
[ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=lRFe1ojb2I3keveG6F1SNMpqnyA5DC-f4K2CG-ffZH4&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_newsletter&n=2) Forward Democrat Ron Ruman is running in a special election, which will be held on primary day. He's popular with independent voters, and expects to appeal to them in the general election this November... but those independent voters often miss special elections that are held on primary day because they're used to being excluded from the primaries. If you live in the York County area, [reach out to Ron's campaign](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=lRFe1ojb2I3keveG6F1SNMpqnyA5DC-f4K2CG-ffZH4&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_newsletter&n=3) and see if you can help.
### 2\. Independents Gathering Signatures
One of the main challenges for independent candidates is organizing volunteers to gather signatures. Are you interested in helping? Then the **best day to do it is primary day**. Signatures can be collected at polling places, giving volunteers easy access to registered voters in the district. (When you're outside the two-party system, you have to work smart to get ahead!). **Contact us ASAP to offer your help- even if it's just a few hours.** [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=s9-xbJ9sz3bHEgiwz34eSeP_9PVXxrs7OtvmmZwVwC8&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_newsletter&n=4) [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=C67zBN9acu3ZSVmLPV47pUdQZk8NryxM-7BS68Thx8D2qdpFaAuEG-y1-R0I3wXv&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_newsletter&n=5) Chris and Rodney are both running for the Pennsylvania State House and have been officially endorsed by the PA Forward Party.
#### Other Independents on Our Radar
We believe that independent candidates deserve more attention, so here are some other independent candidates to consider: [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=9WO7-Xnf8yu_5tCpEnOMYzimbQi3tdmQwRDGziOwWzU42nl8vREdHKYtvkvwRPQy&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_newsletter&n=6) [Isabelle Harman for PA's 10th Congressional District](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=9WO7-Xnf8yu_5tCpEnOMYzimbQi3tdmQwRDGziOwWzU42nl8vREdHKYtvkvwRPQy&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_newsletter&n=7) [Jenn Brothers for PA's 9th Congressional District](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=KO8ZOB0mq2gq63DvFrKfeyK1qZFx7bNIR-pYCJqTbAm2E5qjTfmb3LDdeZ-obBEdLmgPDtRTDoKrdYLbHKr-4Q&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_newsletter&n=8) [Drew Bingaman for PA State House District 108](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=KO8ZOB0mq2gq63DvFrKfeyK1qZFx7bNIR-pYCJqTbAnskGqyFERUHJy-r0gnfT01k3VrmSnvefb7ABjEk_NtIw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_newsletter&n=9) Please let us know of any other candidates you think we should be aware of—even Republicans or Democrats. The Forward Party is a movement of independent thinkers. **Our movement is larger than our party.**
### 3\. Support Open Primaries
There are 2 major groups in PA working to end our closed primary system: [Independent Pennsylvanians](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=Aj0izWy80JeEne78TTwrPFpPDO9hOwBQKKcBHxkOhQs&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_newsletter&n=10) and [Ballot PA](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=Mms7B2UdQS1Z2nazLHo9hBfpa1ZPLPkhp5mlASWe-vo&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_newsletter&n=11). Please check out their work (and sign their petition). Here in the Forward Party, we believe that election reforms are necessary so the system can work better for everyone—not just independents, but Republicans and Democrats too. We all benefit when our elections produce better leaders.
### 4\. Vote on Primary Day!
If you are registered with a major party **(or have a special election in your district),** don't miss primary day on May 19. Let your voice be heard in the most fundamental way: by voting!

clean_body: Primary month! | Primary Day is May 19! Pennsylvania has one of the strictest, most restrictive primary systems in the country—completely closed to anyone who's not willing to register as a Republican or a Democrat. Until that system is reformed (by the work of and their allies, like us), independent voters are inclined to ignore primary elections. Let's talk about what that means for one candidate we've endorsed. 1\. District 196 Special Election Forward Democrat Ron Ruman is running in a special election, which will be held on primary day. He's popular with independent voters, and expects to appeal to them in the general election this November... but those independent voters often miss special elections that are held on primary day because they're used to being excluded from the primaries. If you live in the York County area, and see if you can help. 2\. Independents Gathering Signatures One of the main challenges for independent candidates is organizing volunteers to gather signatures. Are you interested in helping? Then the best day to do it is primary day. Signatures can be collected at polling places, giving volunteers easy access to registered voters in the district. (When you're outside the two-party system, you have to work smart to get ahead!). Contact us ASAP to offer your help- even if it's just a few hours. Chris and Rodney are both running for the Pennsylvania State House and have been officially endorsed by the PA Forward Party. Other Independents on Our Radar We believe that independent candidates deserve more attention, so here are some other independent candidates to consider: Please let us know of any other candidates you think we should be aware of—even Republicans or Democrats. It's been six days since a man with a shotgun, a handgun, and knives breached the White House Correspondents' Dinner (WHCD) and tried to assassinate the president. Two thousand journalists, cabinet officials, and Washington fixtures were mid-dinner at the Washington Hilton when shots rang out.
The man who did it doesn't fit the story we've been telling ourselves.
Cole Tomas Allen was not lurking on the fringes. By all accounts, he was a normal person and highly accomplished. He graduated from [Caltech](https://substack.com/redirect/6bddf080-64b1-47fe-9952-d5d4fd2e1183?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), one of the most selective research universities in the country, with a degree in mechanical engineering. He interned at [NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory](https://substack.com/redirect/7a980ba6-cd17-4cab-b975-8d4ba4648fbc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He had no known ties to extremist groups, no published manifesto on fringe forums, no red flags in any database that would have put him on a watch list.
Tragically, this is the new shape of political violence in America -- not the radicalized loner steeped in ideology, but a highly functioning person who blends into everyday life but takes their grievances to the extreme.
Luigi Mangione, who killed the UnitedHealthcare CEO, was his high school's valedictorian and a University of Penn graduate. Instantly, he became celebrated by corners of the internet as a hero against Big Pharma.
With the WHCD attack, this is now the [third attempt on President Trump's life](https://substack.com/redirect/12801285-c050-4f66-ae2e-9da8c806e4cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from fellow Americans -- more than any other president has faced. No matter where you stand politically, you should never wish violence against any elected official, including the president.
We are now at the point where some of our elected officials in Congress have been through this more than once. Republican leader Steve Scalise, who barely survived a 2017 shooting, said this incident brought back "[bad memories](https://substack.com/redirect/8a7e7066-5b08-4490-b849-24a919675b78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." Still, he helped guide Democratic Rep. Jared Moskowitz to safety, who survived his own assassination plot in 2024.
I think about my congressional classmate Gabby Giffords, who was shot in the head at a constituent event in a Tucson parking lot in 2011. Six people died in that shooting. Just a year ago, our highly popular Pennsylvania Governor [Josh Shapiro](https://substack.com/redirect/01287c04-b439-44b0-a94d-a38a8ffae37d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) had his residence firebombed on the first night of Passover when he and his family were inside.
There is a disturbing pattern here.

Earlier this week, I sat down with Erin Burnett on CNN to talk about our state of political violence and tried my best to remind our political leaders to disagree without being disagreeable, to tone down the personal incendiary and often inhumane attacks. Too many on the far right and far left immediately started pointing fingers instead of calling it out for what it is - a tragic part of American political life these days.

* * *
On Tuesday, I was in D.C. for one of my favorite days of the year. I was at the [Hiring Our Heroes Small Business Awards](https://substack.com/redirect/2e504a65-d215-4944-b9dd-d89edf816e3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- part of the [FedEx Founders Fund](https://substack.com/redirect/81116624-6552-465b-a5a4-755720a03dc6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a program I'm proud to serve as an ambassador for. We award tens of thousands of dollars to the next-gen veterans and military spouse entrepreneurs. The grant is a tribute to FedEx founder Fred Smith, who was a decorated Marine serving two tours in Vietnam and was a lifelong advocate for veterans in the workforce.
More than 1,200 veteran and military spouse-owned businesses applied for this award, with four receiving $10,000 grants and a $25,000 grand prize that went to [Donny and Kim Legans](https://substack.com/redirect/660bd4e9-dca0-4d9c-9860-bfeca3228a8e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- both Air Force veterans -- who took a vacant building one block from Dover's city limits and turned it into a 20,000-square-foot beer garden that's become a community anchor for Dover, Delaware.
Samantha Smith Atkinson, the daughter of the late FedEx founder, was there for the ceremony.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fa5350a1-036f-4fa1-80b6-476b4e4b4662?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e7992704-5f5a-437d-840e-5276990d6158?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This week, I'm heading to LA for the Milken Global Conference, where I'll moderate a panel on veteran entrepreneurship and the access to capital gap. The numbers behind this problem don't get enough attention. There are 1.65 million veteran-owned businesses in this country generating nearly $1 trillion in annual sales -- yet veterans who apply for financing are significantly more likely than their non-veteran peers to receive less than they requested. The underwriting model doesn't distinguish between someone who missed payments and someone who was serving overseas. Too many veterans are drowning in a sea of goodwill with no clear path to capital when they want to start a business. Our conversation will aim to find solutions that bring people together in the same room to get their businesses off the ground.
We talk a lot about honoring those who serve. It's time we start supporting our veterans who aspire for entrepreneurship and give them a path to ownership. Donny and Kim Legans, and the four other businesses recognized Tuesday, are proof that supporting veterans includes funding some of them. That's exactly what I'll be talking about next week. Stay tuned for more.

body:
Generation after generation has been put to the test. Now it’s on us.
---

Peter,
Let’s talk about the power you have.
Because there are a lot of politicians out there who want you to feel powerless and cynical about what’s possible in America — especially during moments like this.
But it’s not up to them. Our nation was built on a simple promise: _**Each of us gets to have a say. **_
That principle is under attack right now. This week’s Supreme Court decisions effectively guts a key pillar of the Voting Rights Act, freeing state legislatures to gerrymander legislative districts to systematically dilute and weaken the voting power of racial minorities.
They don't want their constituents to hold them accountable. That’s why they manipulate maps to get an undeserved advantage. It’s why they make it harder for some to cast their ballots.
It’s being done out of desperation — to cling to power, no matter the cost.
**Peter, we call America an experiment for a reason. Democracy is far from guaranteed.** Generation after generation has been called upon to make this country better. Time after time, we’ve seen groups of ordinary Americans organize, march, and sacrifice to preserve and strengthen democracy.
Now it’s our turn.
Redistricting Action is the grassroots team leading the fight against these attacks on democracy. I’m proud that Attorney General Eric Holder and I started this work, because it takes all of us doing our part in moments like this.
[**This is a moment for all of us who cherish our democratic ideals to mobilize in record numbers. Will you invest in this critical grassroots work today, and help hold the line for democracy?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130530394/618078112/-1482690224?refcode=don_aotl_tier2_email_ObamaApr_email_20260501-AOTL-Tier2-ObamaApr_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260501-AOTL-Tier2-ObamaApr_&utm_campaign=ObamaApr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNiYmExOGFiLTVkNDUtZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=RDlH3oXRI1mI97JsFBUxXdo8kfkTZn78OMOElI4FMMs=)

body:
Read that again.
#

Friends --
The Trump administration is trying to change the rules to let the USPS deliver guns through the mail — with no background checks, licensing, or training.
Read that again.
If Donald Trump’s plans go into effect, it would open up a new gun trafficking channel and make it significantly easier for guns to fall into the wrong hands. We need to take action ASAP.
[**GIFFORDS is on the front lines to stop this dangerous proposal. If you agree, please urgently add your name to tell the USPS to NOT allow guns to be delivered through the mail.**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_uspsrule_q22026/?source=em260501-1-b&refcode2=11440.3935704.Ial0zP&akid=11440%2E3935704%2EIal0zP)
**[ADD MY NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_uspsrule_q22026//?source=em260501-1-b&refcode2=11440.3935704.Ial0zP&akid=11440%2E3935704%2EIal0zP)**
Since 1927, federal law has prohibited the United States Postal Service (USPS) from carrying or delivering handguns as mail — with exceptions for members of the military, law enforcement, and licensed gun manufacturers or dealers.
Donald Trump is trying to change that.
Earlier this year, his Department of Justice issued a memorandum saying that they would no longer enforce this ban.
Now, the USPS is proposing a change to their existing regulations. If it goes into effect, it would mean people who shouldn’t have a gun will be able to go around state and federal laws and have a gun mailed to them — including people with felony convictions.
**This change also means that gun traffickers have a new and comprehensive way to move firearms through America’s communities.**
Our leaders should be keeping us safe — and this is a step in the wrong direction. But the fight isn’t over.
[**Will you please add your name to the growing list of Americans who are saying NO to the USPS’s proposed rule?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_uspsrule_q22026/?source=em260501-1-b&refcode2=11440.3935704.Ial0zP&akid=11440%2E3935704%2EIal0zP)

Thank you,
GIFFORDS
Want to take further action? The best way to voice your opinion directly to the USPS is by sending an email. [**Click here to learn more.**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_uspsrule_q22026_email/?t=1&akid=11440%2E3935704%2EIal0zP)

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. See link below)_ The Justice Department is [investigating](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td2c57e5e-67e0-446b-9c0a-823ea1861d4c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) former FBI Director James Comey over something so ridiculous it would be laughable—if it weren't so dangerous. Seashells. Comey took a picture of seashells in the shape of "8647", and the Justice Department says that is a threat against Trump. Not because is actually is a threat, but because DOJ is now run by sycophantic jackasses willing to do whatever Trump and his increasingly addled brain demand. **This case is bullshit.** [**Take action, and tell DOJ to drop it.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T399c7ed5-63b7-41a5-97e0-1d08b954d0de/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) At a time when inflation is rising, wars are rapidly escalating, and Americans are keenly aware that they may be headed into another great depression, federal law enforcement resources are being directed toward an investigation that is petty, political, and wildly out of proportion. This isn't about justice or an actual threat, it's about making the lives of Trump's political opponents miserable, if they dare to speak out against him. And there is no way in hell we should stand by and let them shred the Constitution, and turn us into an autocracy. [Add your name: "**We call on the Justice Department to immediately drop this absurd and dangerous investigation into James Comey, and to reaffirm its commitment to independence, integrity, and the fair application of justice. "**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T413af59e-9331-43b1-8b0d-9c007a662e18/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Peter, May has always been a bittersweet month for me as a professor.

You spend years challenging your students and watching them grow into their potential. And then, almost all at once, it's over. They're finishing their last requirements, turning in their final papers, and just like that, **as quickly as they first walked into your lecture hall, they're walking across a stage and into the rest of their lives.**

By the time they sit in their regalia, they've persevered through so much, and all they're asking for next is a fair shot.

The government has a role to play in all of this. By ensuring affordable housing, accessible healthcare, and creating good job opportunities right here in our state, we can help open doors for young people instead of closing them. We can make it possible for the next generation not just to get by, but to get ahead.

People who want to stick to the status quo, like Mariannette Miller-Meeks, will tell you it's not possible. For her, maybe not, but I hope you listen to me when I tell you **_it is_** , because I will fight for this future for our kids and us. And I'm not alone; there is so much energy behind our vision.

In fact, I just heard back from my finance director, and we reached our April $25,000 end-of-month goal last night! I can't tell you how grateful I am to have you with me in this race. **[A better future is within reach; we just have to keep up our momentum. Will you make a donation to my campaign to help us keep growing?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130541620/618116212/-2009658230?refcode=em26_260501_EOMTY_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260501_EOMTY_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=7d10a80f-6645-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZDEwYTgwZi02NjQ1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xzz7_spkEmDU3pIi94M6WX-iamuJRy8QtdYfZ9X-F1g=)**

Thank you,

Christina

# **600 groups mobilize for May Day protests as communist organizations align with Democratic Party affiliates**
Some 600 groups--including hard-line communist organizations and Democratic Party affiliates--are organizing an estimated 3,000 May Day protests and events nationwide with combined annual revenue of about $2 billion, **[according to a Fox News Digital investigation.](https://substack.com/redirect/d66702e4-4ae7-4b1f-bf99-9ef1f566d1de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

---|---|---
* **At the center is a network of communist and socialist organizations** led by Democratic Socialists of America chapters and groups funded by American tech tycoon Neville Roy Singham, who lives in Shanghai and promotes Chinese Communist Party propaganda. The "May Day Strong" coalition is calling for Americans to skip work, school and shopping under the banner "Workers Over Billionaires."

* **Democratic Party chapters formally participating** : At least 13 state and local Democratic National Committee chapters are organizing May Day events alongside communist groups, including the California Democratic Party (which has "more than 10 million members"), Ohio Democratic Party Progressive Caucus, North Carolina's Young Democrats of Moore County, Young Democrats of Wisconsin, and Yuba County Democratic Central Committee. Traditional Democratic-aligned organizations like Indivisible (with at least 200 chapters participating), MoveOn.org, American Federation of Teachers, AFL-CIO, National Education Association and United Auto Workers are also mobilizing, with organizers claiming "more than 100,000 students expected to walk out."
* **Critics warn of radical agenda** : Democratic strategist Melissa DeRosa said "The increasing willingness of mainstream Democrats to align with extremist socialist groups is a major factor in why the Democratic Party is losing the center more and more, and why so many lifelong Democrats find themselves feeling politically homeless." Allen, the alleged White House Correspondents' Dinner shooter, attended a "No Kings" protest in Los Angeles before his attack--with his manifesto parroting language used by May Day organizers calling Trump a "pedophile," "traitor" and "rapist."
