# **House passes DHS funding after Johnson drops opposition, ending 76-day agency shutdown**
Speaker Mike Johnson brought the Senate's homeland security appropriations measure to a vote Thursday, **[breaking a months-long impasse that had left most DHS operations unfunded](https://substack.com/redirect/594626a5-b4a7-4adb-a183-3cb35262cf5e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** since early March. Johnson had previously refused to advance the legislation, arguing it contained provisions that would hamper law enforcement capabilities, but changed his position after receiving encouragement from the White House to move forward with the Senate-approved version that had cleared the upper chamber without opposition.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/594626a5-b4a7-4adb-a183-3cb35262cf5e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Presidential intervention shifts dynamics** : Johnson told reporters he had recently spoken with Trump and Senate Majority Leader John Thune, emphasizing the administration, Senate leadership and House were coordinated on the path forward. The speaker stressed he wasn't contradicting White House priorities despite his earlier reservations about specific elements of the legislation. Trump officials had warned their temporary funding workaround for employee compensation would soon be exhausted.
* **Scope and next steps** : The approved measure finances DHS components like TSA, Secret Service, FEMA and CISA through the end of the fiscal year in September. Immigration enforcement agencies including ICE and CBP are expected to receive dedicated appropriations through a separate Republican reconciliation bill currently being developed.

| **TL;DR:** Women in Tennessee are being forced to maintain life-threatening pregnancies—and now the state is trying to silence them. [It's time to stop pretending this criminal abortion ban is working and start protecting women and pregnant people.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/130546825/618127707/2141984067?sourceid=1151320&utm_campaign=26emage-0502aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=tennessee&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTljODI0MC02YTQ1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WILRsSyMm61kSTX-4UIJZ1wBQDWr_h2Wq6qpLVCHa6E=&emci=1ba1901d-cf44-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=619c8240-6a45-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=954237)
* * *
Dear Peter,

We're in Nashville, ready to challenge Tennessee's cruel and dangerous abortion ban in court.

But the state's attorney general just pulled our case off the docket.

[Our plaintiffs are owed their day in court. If Tennessee thinks we’ll back down, they're wrong.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/130546826/618127708/2141984067?sourceid=1151320&utm_campaign=26emage-0502aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=tennessee&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTljODI0MC02YTQ1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WILRsSyMm61kSTX-4UIJZ1wBQDWr_h2Wq6qpLVCHa6E=&emci=1ba1901d-cf44-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=619c8240-6a45-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=954237) | [WE NEED YOUR SUPPORT](https://click.everyaction.com/k/130546827/618127709/2141984067?sourceid=1151320&utm_campaign=26emage-0502aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=tennessee&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTljODI0MC02YTQ1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WILRsSyMm61kSTX-4UIJZ1wBQDWr_h2Wq6qpLVCHa6E=&emci=1ba1901d-cf44-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=619c8240-6a45-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=954237)

Peter—We're fighting for women like Katy Dulong, who, when pregnant with her first child, was diagnosed with cervical insufficiency and told that she would lose the pregnancy. She asked for abortion medication. Instead, she was sent home. [She didn't receive the care she needed for 10 more days.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/130546828/618127710/2141984067?sourceid=1151320&utm_campaign=26emage-0502aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=tennessee&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTljODI0MC02YTQ1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WILRsSyMm61kSTX-4UIJZ1wBQDWr_h2Wq6qpLVCHa6E=&emci=1ba1901d-cf44-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=619c8240-6a45-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=954237) Doctors told her she was extremely lucky to survive.

Our plaintiffs deserve to tell their stories, stories that show how politicians have put their lives, and the lives of anyone who becomes pregnant in Tennessee, in danger. But instead of facing those stories, the state enacted laws making it harder for anyone to sue—and took our case off the docket.

[Tennessee should have to face the consequences of its policies and bear witness to these women's stories.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/130546830/618127711/2141984067?sourceid=1151320&utm_campaign=26emage-0502aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=tennessee&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTljODI0MC02YTQ1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WILRsSyMm61kSTX-4UIJZ1wBQDWr_h2Wq6qpLVCHa6E=&emci=1ba1901d-cf44-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=619c8240-6a45-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=954237)
[WE'RE NOT DONE](https://click.everyaction.com/k/130546832/618127712/2141984067?sourceid=1151320&utm_campaign=26emage-0502aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=tennessee&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTljODI0MC02YTQ1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WILRsSyMm61kSTX-4UIJZ1wBQDWr_h2Wq6qpLVCHa6E=&emci=1ba1901d-cf44-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=619c8240-6a45-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=954237)

Attorney General Jonathan Skrmetti doesn't want you to know that women are going septic. That they're being forced to carry pregnancies only to deliver stillborns. [This is the reality they don't want you to see.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/130546835/618127713/2141984067?sourceid=1151320&utm_campaign=26emage-0502aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=tennessee&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTljODI0MC02YTQ1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WILRsSyMm61kSTX-4UIJZ1wBQDWr_h2Wq6qpLVCHa6E=&emci=1ba1901d-cf44-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=619c8240-6a45-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=954237)

We will keep fighting for them and every Tennessean who deserves access to essential health care.

subject: STOPPING the SAVE Act >>>>

body:
We can’t back down now.
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/108422?t=6&akid=24063%2E878179%2E7V99wE) Just a few weeks ago, Trump’s dangerous SAVE Act that would disenfranchise MILLIONS was basically a done deal.

**But thanks to Senate Democrats’ relentless fight, we’re inches away from DESTROYING this bill for good — and SAVING voting rights!**

[**We’re calling on EVERY supporter reading this to join the fight and THANK Senate Democrats for defending our democracy »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/108422?t=7&akid=24063%2E878179%2E7V99wE) | [**THANK SENATE DEMOCRATS: DONATE $3 TO SIGN »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/108422?t=8&akid=24063%2E878179%2E7V99wE)
---
TO: Senate Democrats
FROM: A grateful Democrat
Subject: Thank you! Dear Senate Democrats,

**Thank you for fighting TIRELESSLY against Trump’s disgusting SAVE Act that would disenfranchise married women, target poll workers, and destroy vote-by-mail.**

This is true heroism — and exactly the kind of leadership we need to defeat Republicans’ disgusting attacks on the American people!

It’s clear: Trump wouldn’t be doing this if he wasn’t TERRIFIED. He KNOWS Democrats are on track to end his MAGA trifecta in November.

**He’ll do everything in his power to silence our votes, but with a strong grassroots coalition on our side, I know we can stop him.**

[**So I'm signing this letter and donating $3 to the Voter Protection Project to THANK YOU for putting it all on the line to save our country and to help FLIP the majorities this November! »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/108422?t=9&akid=24063%2E878179%2E7V99wE) | [**RUSH $3 TO SIGN ON BEFORE WE CLOSE THIS LETTER AT MIDNIGHT »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/108422?t=10&akid=24063%2E878179%2E7V99wE)

subject: 🚨 Your Weekly Update From The NEGOP
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Nebraska Republican Party 1610 N St
body:
News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong.
| | | | |
---
| Letter from the Chair
---
The Life of a Party Chairman: Leading with Purpose, Humor, and Unshakable Resolve
One of the greatest gifts I carry is the ability to find humor in almost everything--even in the whacky world of politics. As the primary heats up, the questions pour in: "What are you doing about...?" and "Why haven't you done...?" I often wish every concerned Republican could walk a day in my shoes. Boredom? Never on the agenda. The pace is relentless, but these concerns roll off my back because I know they come from a place of deep passion for our shared values and the future of our state and nation.
Too often, though, the loudest voices aren't the ones showing up on volunteer sign-up sheets or donor lists. Real change isn't built by complaints--it's built by commitment. And that's exactly what we're delivering. We continuing our work with organizing Days of Action in crucial districts and by hosting trainings on data usage and field programs.
Our printing, mailing, and postage program is firing on all cylinders. We're helping both state and local candidates secure the best possible rates on yard signs, mailers, and postage--saving precious campaign resources so every dollar goes toward winning hearts and minds. We've established a strong rhythm in this primary that will carry us seamlessly into an even busier, more victorious general election. I've learned more about postal regulations than I ever dreamed possible, and I've genuinely enjoyed building relationships with our friends at the Lincoln Post Office who help make it all happen.
This week, we issued a strong press release calling out Senator Meghan Hunt's tone-deaf and inflammatory rhetoric directed at UNK students. In the shadow of a third assassination attempt on President Trump and the heartbreaking on-campus assassination of Charlie Kirk just over seven months ago, the radical Left's continued recklessness is staggering. We will not stay silent while they endanger our leaders, our values, and our communities.
In the CD2 congressional primary, Democrats are flooding the race with money in a desperate attempt to take control of the seat. I've spoken with several media outlets about it, and I remain confident. We have an outstanding candidate in Brinker Harding--a man of integrity, dignity, and genuine connection. While his Democrat opponents trip over themselves trying to "out-left" one another, Brinker stands strong on principle. The contrast between the parties has never been clearer, and with the full support of the NEGOP, we will give Nebraska voters the sharp choice they deserve.
Meanwhile, preparations for the State Convention are in full swing. We're still awaiting to finalize results from nearly twenty county conventions. Leadership transitions are normal in a party as vibrant and active as ours, but the timing--right before the primary--adds urgency. Tracking down county leaders, crafting emails that actually get read, and mobilizing volunteers demands real time and effort. Yet we're doing it: speakers are being confirmed, agendas finalized, and exciting events planned for our June 6th Convention. This will be a powerful gathering of unified, energized Nebraska Republicans ready to take the fight forward. Mediation is another daily reality. Passionate people sometimes clash--over parliamentary questions, constitutional interpretations, or bruised feelings. As State Chair, I step in as mediator because strong convictions are a feature of our party, not a bug. Disappointment and frustration come with the territory when you fight for big things. But we channel that energy into productive action.
At the end of every long day, what sustains me is simple: core beliefs and enduring values. The belief in limited government, individual liberty, strong families, free enterprise, and a Nebraska where opportunity is real and freedom is protected. No matter how tiring the work becomes, I rise each morning focused on a bigger vision--a unified Nebraska Republican Party that stands shoulder to shoulder, working together for what is good, right, and noble.
We are not just electing candidates. We are defending a way of life. We are fighting for the Nebraska we love and the America we know can be great again.
Thank you for standing with us. Let's keep moving forward--together.
Onward to Victory,
For Nebraska, Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party

clean_body: News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong. | | | | | | Letter from the Chair The Life of a Party Chairman: Leading with Purpose, Humor, and Unshakable Resolve One of the greatest gifts I carry is the ability to find humor in almost everything--even in the whacky world of politics. As the primary heats up, the questions pour in: "What are you doing about...?" and "Why haven't you done...?" I often wish every concerned Republican could walk a day in my shoes. Boredom? Never on the agenda. The pace is relentless, but these concerns roll off my back because I know they come from a place of deep passion for our shared values and the future of our state and nation. Too often, though, the loudest voices aren't the ones showing up on volunteer sign-up sheets or donor lists. Real change isn't built by complaints--it's built by commitment. And that's exactly what we're delivering. We continuing our work with organizing Days of Action in crucial districts and by hosting trainings on data usage and field programs. Our printing, mailing, and postage program is firing on all cylinders. We're helping both state and local candidates secure the best possible rates on yard signs, mailers, and postage--saving precious campaign resources so every dollar goes toward winning hearts and minds. We've established a strong rhythm in this primary that will carry us seamlessly into an even busier, more victorious general election. I've learned more about postal regulations than I ever dreamed possible, and I've genuinely enjoyed building relationships with our friends at the Lincoln Post Office who help make it all happen. This week, we issued a strong press release calling out Senator Meghan Hunt's tone-deaf and inflammatory rhetoric directed at UNK students. In the shadow of a third assassination attempt on President Trump and the heartbreaking on-campus assassination of Charlie Kirk just over seven months ago, the radical Left's continued recklessness is staggering. We will not stay silent while they endanger our leaders, our values, and our communities. In the CD2 congressional primary, Democrats are flooding the race with money in a desperate attempt to take control of the seat. I've spoken with several media outlets about it, and I remain confident. We have an outstanding candidate in Brinker Harding--a man of integrity, dignity, and genuine connection. While his Democrat opponents trip over themselves trying to "out-left" one another, Brinker stands strong on principle. The contrast between the parties has never been clearer, and with the full support of the NEGOP, we will give Nebraska voters the sharp choice they deserve. Meanwhile, preparations for the State Convention are in full swing. We're still awaiting to finalize results from nearly twenty county conventions. Leadership transitions are normal in a party as vibrant and active as ours, but the timing--right before the primary--adds urgency. Tracking down county leaders, crafting emails that actually get read, and mobilizing volunteers demands real time and effort. Yet we're doing it: speakers are being confirmed, agendas finalized, and exciting events planned for our June 6th Convention. This will be a powerful gathering of unified, energized Nebraska Republicans ready to take the fight forward. Mediation is another daily reality. Passionate people sometimes clash--over parliamentary questions, constitutional interpretations, or bruised feelings. As State Chair, I step in as mediator because strong convictions are a feature of our party, not a bug. Disappointment and frustration come with the territory when you fight for big things. But we channel that energy into productive action. At the end of every long day, what sustains me is simple: core beliefs and enduring values. The belief in limited government, individual liberty, strong families, free enterprise, and a Nebraska where opportunity is real and freedom is protected. No matter how tiring the work becomes, I rise each morning focused on a bigger vision--a unified Nebraska Republican Party that stands shoulder to shoulder, working together for what is good, right, and noble. name: KAREN CRNKOVICH FOR JOHNSON COUNTY COMMISSION
subject: Everyone Points Fingers. No One Takes Responsibility.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY KAREN CRNKOVICH FOR JOHNSON COUNTY COMMISSION * 6709 West 119th Street * Ste
body:
If you've ever looked at your ever-increasing property tax bill and wondered....

| | | | | |
---
| |

Dear Peter,If you’ve ever looked at your ever-increasing property tax bill and wondered,
**“Who is responsible for this?”** You’re not alone.Because when it comes to rising property taxes in Johnson County, everyone seems to have an answer _and it’s always pointing somewhere else._ The county blames the state.
The state says they’re not responsible.
School districts point to growth and rising needs.And yet...**Our population has only grown about 4% over the past five years.** So if population growth isn’t driving this, what is?The truth is simple:**Everyone plays a role. And no one is taking responsibility.** Property taxes don’t rise by accident. They rise because of decisions.
Budget decisions. Spending decisions. Leadership decisions.When every entity increases spending...
When no one exercises discipline...
When no one is willing to say “no”...**Taxpayers pay the price.** That’s exactly what we’re seeing today.Instead of coordination and accountability, we have a system where each layer of government expands, spends, and then deflects.That’s not leadership.That’s how you end up with rising tax bills, frustrated families, and a community asking the same question year after year:**“Why does this keep happening?”** I’m running for Johnson County Commission Chair because I’m willing to give you a straight answer:It happens because of a **lack of fiscal discipline and accountability at every level.** And it will not change until we elect leaders who are willing to take responsibility, not pass it.As a business owner, I don’t get to blame someone else when costs rise. I have to make decisions. I have to prioritize. I have to live within a budget.Our government should be no different.But changing this won’t be easy.We are up against a system that is comfortable with the status quo and a pattern of spending that has gone unchecked for far too long.**That’s why I need your help.**
---
|
---
| [DONATE TODAY](https://us.list-manage.com/NggyblQyt8J?e=7320325a61&c2id=7adf4106091b2bdf32986c5b36d3a494)
---
| |

We are $1,300 away from our month-end goal, and every contribution, whether $25, $50, $100 or more helps us reach voters, share the truth, and build the momentum needed to bring real accountability back to Johnson County.If you’re tired of finger-pointing...
If you’re ready for real answers...
If you believe it’s time for leadership that takes responsibility...Then I’m asking you to stand with me.Together, we can fix this.With determination,
**Karen Crnkovich
** Candidate for Johnson County Commission Chair

Dear Friend, What happens when a state lawmaker refuses to go along with the political script?Sometimes, it changes the course of history.This week, we saw exactly that. From a pivotal moment on the Louisiana House floor to major legislative victories and strategic wins across the states, Freedom Caucus members continue to prove that principled leadership delivers results. Strap in. This email is filled with amazing victories.

|

**LOUISIANA LAWMAKER SHAPES SCOTUS CASE**This week, the U.S. Supreme Court’s decision in **Louisiana v. Callais** marked a decisive turning point in the fight against racial gerrymandering. But the most important moment in the case didn’t happen in a courtroom.It happened on the Louisiana House floor.During debate over the congressional map, **Louisiana Freedom Caucus Chairwoman Rep. Beryl Amedée** forced a moment of clarity about how the map was being drawn. Her exchange was later cited in legal briefs as evidence that the map was engineered using race-based criteria under court pressure.In other words, what one of our lawmakers said on the House floor became part of the legal foundation for a case that reached the Supreme Court.And it mattered. Legal experts point to that moment as a key factor in the Court’s decision, helping expose the underlying rationale behind the map and ultimately contributing to the outcome.It is a powerful reminder that what happens in state legislatures does not stay in state legislatures. When lawmakers are willing to speak clearly and stand on principle, it can shape outcomes all the way up to the United States Supreme Court.Watch the moment here:

**SOUTH CAROLINA SAVES TAXPAYERS** A major “roads” bill in South Carolina started out the way these things usually do.More taxes. More bureaucracy. Bigger government.The bill was sold as a plan to fix the roads, but it came with tax hikes and expanded government regulations.The **South Carolina Freedom Caucus** stepped in early. They publicly opposed the bill, educated voters on what it actually did, and made it politically costly for lawmakers to support it.That pressure worked.As public scrutiny increased, lawmakers who initially supported the bill began to back away.Leadership no longer had the votes.So they rewrote the bill.The new version:Does not raise taxes. Removes the added bureaucracy. Shifts the focus to cutting spending to pay for roads.That is the model.Speak early. Educate the public. Apply pressure. Change the outcome.

clean_body: | | | | | Dear Friend, What happens when a state lawmaker refuses to go along with the political script?Sometimes, it changes the course of history.This week, we saw exactly that. From a pivotal moment on the Louisiana House floor to major legislative victories and strategic wins across the states, Freedom Caucus members continue to prove that principled leadership delivers results. Strap in. This email is filled with amazing victories. | LOUISIANA LAWMAKER SHAPES SCOTUS CASEThis week, the U.S. Supreme Court’s decision in Louisiana v. Callais marked a decisive turning point in the fight against racial gerrymandering. But the most important moment in the case didn’t happen in a courtroom.It happened on the Louisiana House floor.During debate over the congressional map, Louisiana Freedom Caucus Chairwoman Rep. Beryl Amedée forced a moment of clarity about how the map was being drawn. Her exchange was later cited in legal briefs as evidence that the map was engineered using race-based criteria under court pressure.In other words, what one of our lawmakers said on the House floor became part of the legal foundation for a case that reached the Supreme Court.And it mattered. Legal experts point to that moment as a key factor in the Court’s decision, helping expose the underlying rationale behind the map and ultimately contributing to the outcome.It is a powerful reminder that what happens in state legislatures does not stay in state legislatures. When lawmakers are willing to speak clearly and stand on principle, it can shape outcomes all the way up to the United States Supreme Court.Watch the moment here: | SOUTH CAROLINA SAVES TAXPAYERS A major “roads” bill in South Carolina started out the way these things usually do.More taxes. More bureaucracy. Bigger government.The bill was sold as a plan to fix the roads, but it came with tax hikes and expanded government regulations.The South Carolina Freedom Caucus stepped in early. They publicly opposed the bill, educated voters on what it actually did, and made it politically costly for lawmakers to support it.That pressure worked.As public scrutiny increased, lawmakers who initially supported the bill began to back away.Leadership no longer had the votes.So they rewrote the bill.The new version:Does not raise taxes. Removes the added bureaucracy. Shifts the focus to cutting spending to pay for roads.That is the model.Speak early. Educate the public. Apply pressure. Change the outcome. | MISSOURI WINS With only days left in the legislative session, the Missouri Freedom Caucus released a summary of what they have accomplished this year.Among the highlights:A $4 billion reduction in the state budget An income tax repeal measure heading to the November ballotA major regulatory reform bill to rein in the administrative stateThese are not symbolic victories.They are real policy wins that reduce the size and scope of government and deliver results for taxpayers.This is what happens when a Freedom Caucus has enough influence to shape outcomes, not just comment on them. | RADIO CLIP OF THE WEEK On last week's episode of State Freedom Caucus Unfiltered , Maricopa County Recorder, Justin Heap - an Arizona Freedom Caucus alum - explains the importance of having a freedom caucus in the state legislature. Watch the clip below. 🎧 Subscribe on (or on your preferred podcast platform)📣 Follow us on X \- 🎵 Follow us on TikTok \- 👍 Follow us on Facebook \- | QUICK HITS⚡️Minnesota — A Minnesota lawmaker criticized an outside group for calling a bill anti-Second Amendment. The Minnesota Freedom Caucus responded by the exact language from the bill, proving the point. Most lawmakers do not read the bills. Freedom Caucus members do. ️️⚡️Oklahoma — The Oklahoma Freedom Caucus forced a vote on a bill to block welfare benefits for illegal aliens. Despite strong support in the House, liberal Republicans joined Democrats to kill it in the Senate. The OK Freedom Caucus voters know exactly who was responsible. | WE NEED YOUR HELP TO KEEP THE MOMENTUM The victories you read about in this email do not happen on their own.They happen because Freedom Caucus members are willing to challenge the political establishment, force tough votes, and tell voters the truth about what is really happening in their state capitols. The State Freedom Caucus Network exists to support these lawmakers, expand the Freedom Caucus model into more states, and help conservatives fight back where it matters most.If you want to help us keep building this movement, please support our work today. We'll be back with another update soon. Until then, please be sure to our efforts so that we can support our State Freedom Caucuses!In Liberty, Andy RothPresidentState Freedom Caucus Network | |

Hi folks,

It’s campaign season in California.

This time of year, Dr. Weber wears two hats. In her official capacity, she oversees California’s elections and fights to expand ballot access.

But in her capacity as a candidate and activist, this season means visiting Democratic clubs and activists in every corner of our state, sharing her vision for a more just future.

Dr. Weber has already crisscrossed our state physically and digitally. Here’s a taste of the latest from the campaign trail:

Democratic clubs:
Dr. Weber has shown up — in person and virtually — for Democratic clubs from one end of the state to the other. That includes the La Mesa Foothills Democratic Club, the East County Democratic Club, the Martin Luther King Democratic Club, the Antelope Valley Democrats for Change, the San Diego Democrats for Equality, the Tehachapi Mountain Democratic Club, and the Placer Women Democrats' Annual Leadership Luncheon, just to name a few.

Whether it was a keynote address, an endorsement meeting, or a regular monthly gathering, Dr. Weber was there – ready to listen and lead.

Community & Labor:
Throughout her career, Dr. Weber has recognized that workers and their advocates are central to the future of California.

This year, she’s been proud to meet with a variety of labor organizations, from the ILWU Southern California District Council to the leadership of the United Domestic Workers. Dr. Weber has always defended the dignity of work and the rights of Californians to join a union – that’s why labor groups have overwhelmingly endorsed her re-election campaign.

Getting out the vote:
As we get closer to the June primary, Dr. Weber is coordinating with organizations across the state to educate voters and ensure everyone is able to cast their ballots without issue.

As Dr. Weber always says, democracy requires active participation. That means showing up, fostering community, and working together to build a better world.

With gratitude and determination,

-Team Weber

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. Dear Peter,
I just got back from Texas, where I visited multiple federal detention centers. When I got home, I learned Donald Trump is trying to rebrand his cruel immigration enforcers, who’ve imprisoned children, forcibly separated families, and killed people, from ICE to NICE.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q2?refcode=x_260501_TexasUpdate_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q2?refcode=x_260501_TexasUpdate_act]
As an American, a physician, a mother, and a human being, I am livid. We need to vote these cruel fascists out of office and reinstate justice. We need to defund and dismantle ICE NOW.
At one facility, federal officials prevented me from speaking with the detained children, even though their attorneys had coordinated consent prior to my arrival.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q2?refcode=x_260501_TexasUpdate_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q2?refcode=x_260501_TexasUpdate_act]
At another facility, I spent the morning talking to detainees who have done absolutely nothing to justify being locked up: green card holders, asylum seekers, people without criminal records, and children held for months.
My team helped attain over 60 privacy release forms for people in the Dilley family detention facility so that their members of Congress can advocate on their behalf. If we hadn’t been there, they wouldn’t have had the chance.
Justice shouldn’t depend on luck. That’s the opposite of how justice works.
Donald Trump, his MAGA administration, and his GOP enablers are choking off access to basic due process. Their cruelty is intentional. We must DEMAND that our justice and immigration systems follow the rule of law.
If you’re with me, consider supporting our movement. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q2?refcode=x_260501_TexasUpdate_act]

Dr. Maxine Dexter

Friend,

No one likes asking for help. Most of us have worked hard all our lives to be self-sufficient and provide for our families.

But for our January 6 patriots still waiting on pardons -- good individuals who answered the call to peacefully protest a stolen election -- the last five-plus years have been nothing short of a nightmare.

Luckily, **the Trump Department of Justice has rightly asked the court to vacate the charges and convictions against the unpardoned Proud Boys and Oath Keepers leaders** and dismiss the cases with prejudice.

After years of weaponized prosecutions under the Biden regime, this is the right step toward real justice.

**But a new threat has emerged -- not from the DOJ, but from the radical left in Congress.**

Congressman Jamie Raskin -- one of the most partisan Democrats in Washington -- filed an amicus brief in three separate appeals in the D.C. Circuit to defend the original jury verdicts.

**Our side 's attorneys had to drop everything and work around the clock all weekend to draft a strong opposition brief! **

The filing deadline is extremely tight -- early this week.

These patriots have been completely financially drained after more than five years of brutal legal battles, imprisonment, and persecution. Many are veterans who served our country honorably, only to be treated like enemies of the state by their own government. They simply do not have the resources to fund this critical fight on their own while still dealing with other lingering issues.

**Stand in the Gap has stepped in to raise emergency funds so their legal team can file a powerful response -- on time and with strength.**

That is why we need your help today, Friend.

Our goal is to raise at least $120,000 this week to defend the 12 individuals involved.

Every dollar you give helps protect the rule of law, push back against leftist interference, and stand in the gap for these American patriots.

[Please help us fight this battle by donating today.](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=d81d129c46614105830952d2b3124d9f&_e=0bZtYUbEVdgOV6Y0KboMT9NokcxjIg8mKybitMP2pmbgREYEpwMC-SNTreCoxw0kC90pEFtbYxt8zNnEuiMCMyMWiDHi5XjrRRdAfxhf5V4gPt7WnLf7GD3EiONKtkpXjRo8voURCDo-b-8Rl9ytEDU7BqxBnqoj8lQ1rbbvM3fHzOlba3K1xyq43K9hMbp6v9Mcd2yjveZQmuIu4g3yGcTXKTJcTo3995T1Vp19FeR2nCRyNUap4jh-MEjP-w7Qy5tDBrShbx1WxpX4hmH26lP00VCYqbKb0vv3Jqb3B6b9PTQTyywWgprFTCqKzdJYyPMTIAohl9ESd__SsnlfZU0ilxqwMAZqTFa-EGJYGW-HRZTt7cxjVfKwOhxRDpi3jEM1itKVeIRCmb7HE0u3HzzxJMfZs-UtoRCWK4PtXBr-HJVTrCra50kOskOakHSjtjziIU32UBGHkvePA0LuWMnMR3IsmrtPymB2tjcfWhdjtgw-QaHcjjs9f-3WKvOAsonwlC0fZMpZ8vg9c3wbXi-EhjhonwCerFI0ptsU30BU7n0PfhbHEBS-g6c_uIoWXwjq6TZPvS5XXb7HBL7FduKZxaaupCa2DCZwO7i9uU4vIAAxM0YYRdp5icHAqSVf) Or keep reading to learn exactly who these individuals are -- many of them veterans -- why they were unfairly targeted, and why this fight matters to every conservative who believes in fairness and justice.

subject: They charged him with a felony for stopping a riot
body:
Dear Patriot,
They charged a cop with a felony for stopping a riot. I am not making this up.
They want to lock him away for using **non-lethal bean bag rounds** against a violent mob that was blocking an interstate highway, hurling rocks at officers, and bringing Molotov cocktails to the party.
I have seen a lot in my years in law enforcement. I have seen politics poison the justice system. But what is being done to Officer Jeffrey Teng of Austin, Texas is one of the most shameless, stomach-turning betrayals of law enforcement I have ever witnessed.
** [It has to stop — and I need your help to stop it.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=753587a2d8954d1688e55e733cc9859a&_e=IaBiCf-M5JVemlBPvMkgv2NCIY41vImb4T_7JP3w97WLpEKjNjMkYoCpCaSd2Eu7Zj0Hffb7qCOf-sCFL8fuio2LGe7R_3nusZRvMcTHqHJJVGl4TZtx5u1T5A9_RWmE28dEXFtHR4Z3HsLMxIqapWmQcziu3lDFTpdq_D-MMcbW5lCbmYJYkML879XNCJIHVnYLTtOkWfSc8hnjOAkJW0DQsokSCelPraDBC_7hqKEdgR-2g0ZoCVFqPEmo-4QYR_VRMxlKEW2gQIeuwcQbUxl_5ZEOdBUwfzn6iuZwZAOsfTRCj3zyNdt6ysF_RkdFxhrtk9eX70PxfdrjSKEJlRnVp24qH5NU-H3ylbuJkjoLJJlYZ_TiDkL5VhixSKxfANzJfPUa8KnJmxx38_raBWZZh5I0dIm11wYDiB9h4zSFOAoEcU6ch_2ScCmXKBkn) **
It was Memorial Day weekend, 2020. Hundreds of protesters flooded the streets of Austin. What started as a demonstration turned into three days of chaos: buildings looted, police vehicles set on fire, a rioter caught with a Molotov cocktail before he could throw it. It took nearly Austin's entire 2,100-officer police force to keep the city from total collapse.
On May 31st, a mob completely shut down I-35 — a major interstate highway — directly in front of police headquarters. Ambulances couldn't get through. Officers gave verbal orders to disperse. A police helicopter broadcast commands over a loudspeaker. The rioters refused.
**Officer Jeffrey Teng and his partner were ordered in to clear the highway.**
Officer Jeffrey Teng with his wife
When they arrived, the mob started throwing rocks. One of those rocks struck Officer Teng's partner square in the chest. Under attack, outnumbered, doing their jobs — Teng and his fellow officers deployed non-lethal rounds to stop the violence.
That's it. That's the "crime."
Now Jeffrey Teng, along with 4 other Austin police officers, faces felony charges. Meanwhile, District Attorney José Garza has dismissed nearly every charge against the actual rioters. The people who threw rocks, set cars on fire, and shut down a highway walk free. The officers who stopped them are being prosecuted.
This is a political vendetta by a DA who has made it his mission to destroy the men and women who keep order in our streets.
And Jeff Teng is paying the price. His career is on hold. His future is uncertain. His trial has been delayed again and again — meaning this family has been living under this cloud for _years_ with no end in sight.
The National Center for Police Defense is standing with Jeff and his family — funding his legal defense and providing support while this ordeal drags on. But we cannot do it without you.

clean_body: Dear Patriot, They charged a cop with a felony for stopping a riot. I am not making this up. They want to lock him away for using non-lethal bean bag rounds against a violent mob that was blocking an interstate highway, hurling rocks at officers, and bringing Molotov cocktails to the party. I have seen a lot in my years in law enforcement. I have seen politics poison the justice system. But what is being done to Officer Jeffrey Teng of Austin, Texas is one of the most shameless, stomach-turning betrayals of law enforcement I have ever witnessed. It was Memorial Day weekend, 2020. Hundreds of protesters flooded the streets of Austin. What started as a demonstration turned into three days of chaos: buildings looted, police vehicles set on fire, a rioter caught with a Molotov cocktail before he could throw it. It took nearly Austin's entire 2,100-officer police force to keep the city from total collapse. On May 31st, a mob completely shut down I-35 — a major interstate highway — directly in front of police headquarters. Ambulances couldn't get through. Officers gave verbal orders to disperse. A police helicopter broadcast commands over a loudspeaker. The rioters refused. Officer Jeffrey Teng and his partner were ordered in to clear the highway. Officer Jeffrey Teng with his wife When they arrived, the mob started throwing rocks. One of those rocks struck Officer Teng's partner square in the chest. Under attack, outnumbered, doing their jobs — Teng and his fellow officers deployed non-lethal rounds to stop the violence. That's it. That's the "crime." Now Jeffrey Teng, along with 4 other Austin police officers, faces felony charges. Meanwhile, District Attorney José Garza has dismissed nearly every charge against the actual rioters. The people who threw rocks, set cars on fire, and shut down a highway walk free. The officers who stopped them are being prosecuted. This is a political vendetta by a DA who has made it his mission to destroy the men and women who keep order in our streets. And Jeff Teng is paying the price. His career is on hold. His future is uncertain. His trial has been delayed again and again — meaning this family has been living under this cloud for years with no end in sight. The National Center for Police Defense is standing with Jeff and his family — funding his legal defense and providing support while this ordeal drags on. But we cannot do it without you. I'm asking you to . $25. $50. $100. Whatever you can. Your gift goes to Jeff's defense and to supporting his family through this nightmare. Stand With Officer Teng Today Your gift funds Jeff's legal defense and supports his family through this nightmare. 100% of your donation goes toward Officer Teng's legal defense fund. The radical left is counting on your silence. They want you to think this is just one officer, one city, one story. It isn't. If they can prosecute 20+ officers for stopping a riot with non-lethal force, no officer anywhere is safe. Jeff Teng showed up. He held the line. He protected his partner, his city, and the rule of law — with every tool he was authorized to use. The least we can do is show up for him. Don't look away. Share this with every law enforcement supporter you know. And please, For Jeff. For every officer they're coming after next. Sincerely, Sheriff Joe Arpaio Former Sheriff, Maricopa County, Arizona Honorary Supporter, National Center for Police Defense P.S. Officer Jeff Teng is facing felony charges for stopping a riot. This week, the Supreme Court **gutted the Voting Rights Act of 1965.** The decision is absurd — it will decimate black and brown representation and it ignores centuries of entrenched bigotry.

Across the country the Voting Rights Act has protected minority representation in Congress and in state legislatures. This week, within hours of the ruling, Alabama and Florida started to pass maps that will dramatically reduce the number of black members of Congress and their state legislatures.

I stand with Ketanji Brown Jackson, Sonia Sotomayor and Elena Kagan — the Voting Rights Act is not only Constitutional, but essential. I stand with Ketanji Brown Jackson, Sonia Sotomayor and Elena Kagan — the Voting Rights Act is not only Constitutional, but essential. Peter,
I’m co-leading legislation to raise the minimum wage to $25 an hour—a real living wage in today’s economy.
Let me tell you why.
In 1968, the minimum wage was worth about $14/hour in today’s dollars. Today? It’s just $7.25.
Meanwhile, worker productivity has more than doubled. So workers are producing more than ever and getting paid less.
That’s not an accident. It’s a system that funnels wealth to the top while working people fall behind.
We’re going to change that.
Sign if you agree: America deserves a $25 minimum wage. https://x.com/RoKhanna/status/2049212088141205955 [https://x.com/RoKhanna/status/2049212088141205955]
A $25 minimum wage means:
* Fewer families living paycheck to paycheck
* More money in local economies
* Real dignity for work
Right now, millions of Americans are working full-time and still can’t afford rent, groceries, or healthcare. That’s not the American Dream.
We can fix it. But we have to build massive popular pressure to push Congress to act.

Ro

body:
Gov. Lee and the GOP legislature are calling a special session to strip Memphis of its representation in Congress. Sign the petition to stop this power grab. | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130568278/618184783/-1977837920?refcode=5.1.26_petition&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NWQ2NWMxNi04MjQ1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mF8S3XeYkj6_UuyU4OYdgoZz_SHXcNQ_rr-bYfETKoA=&emci=7bfe1685-7845-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=75d65c16-8245-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=53531271)
---
Friend, This morning, I was standing blocks from the Lorraine Motel, where Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. lost his life. Just blocks from the site of the Memphis Massacre of 1866, where newly freed people were raped and murdered, and their homes were set ablaze, all for asserting their rights after the Civil War. Just blocks from where blood was shed in the fight for dignity, equality, and the fundamental right to be heard.

**People marched on these streets.
People were beaten on these streets.
People died on these streets— _because they believed every American deserves equal representation under the law._** _And now, generations later, Donald Trump, Bill Lee, and Marsha Blackburn want to drag us backwards._ __ It’s that simple. They are openly attempting to weaken voting rights and dilute political power in communities they don’t like. First, it’s schemes like the SAVE Act that could make it harder for millions of Americans—especially married women whose names may not match their birth certificates—to vote. Now, they want to redraw Tennessee’s maps again to strip Memphis of representation. **Let’s call this what it is: a power grab.**

An attempt to silence voters in one of the largest Black communities in the South because they don’t like how we vote. **Republicans may try to steal your voice, but they cannot steal your power unless you surrender it. We will never surrender it.** **[Sign our petition: Tell Governor Lee and the Tennessee Legislature to keep their hands off our maps and leave Mempnhis the hell alone.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130568279/618184784/952433470?refcode=5.1.26_petition&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NWQ2NWMxNi04MjQ1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mF8S3XeYkj6_UuyU4OYdgoZz_SHXcNQ_rr-bYfETKoA=&emci=7bfe1685-7845-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=75d65c16-8245-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=53531271)** | | [SIGN OUR PETITION](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130568280/618184785/952433470?refcode=5.1.26_petition&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NWQ2NWMxNi04MjQ1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mF8S3XeYkj6_UuyU4OYdgoZz_SHXcNQ_rr-bYfETKoA=&emci=7bfe1685-7845-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=75d65c16-8245-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=53531271)
---
They are trying to rig the game because they are terrified of the people.
Just hours after the Supreme Court opened the door even wider for partisan gerrymandering, Marsha Blackburn and her allies started pushing to reconvene the legislature for one reason and one reason only:
To carve up Memphis.
To dilute our voice.
To make sure some Tennesseans count less than others.
They may try to package this as “good for Memphis.”
**Don’t buy it.**
What’s good for Memphis is when every voter is heard. What’s good for Memphis is fair representation. What’s good for Memphis is democracy—not politicians choosing their voters behind closed doors.

Because if your ideas are strong, you shouldn’t need to rig the maps to win.
_But their policies are failing working people.
Their agenda is unpopular.
**And instead of changing course, they’re trying to change the rules.**_
They want to choose their voters instead of letting voters choose them.
**But here’s what they still don’t understand about Tennessee:**
**You cannot gerrymander courage. You cannot redraw conviction.
And you cannot erase the power of people who are organized and determined to fight back.**
_And here’s what Marsha Blackburn should be worried about:_
You can gerrymander a congressional district.
_**You cannot gerrymander a statewide election.**_
_****_
You cannot redraw the borders of Tennessee.
In a governor’s race, every vote matters the same—whether it comes from Memphis, Chattanooga, Nashville, Knoxville, or a small town that politicians only visit during election years.
So if they want to make this election about power, we’ll make it about people.
If they want fear, we’ll answer with organization.
If they want division, we’ll answer with turnout.
And we will build something too big to rig.

clean_body: Gov. Lee and the GOP legislature are calling a special session to strip Memphis of its representation in Congress. Sign the petition to stop this power grab. | Friend, This morning, I was standing blocks from the Lorraine Motel, where Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. lost his life. Just blocks from the site of the Memphis Massacre of 1866, where newly freed people were raped and murdered, and their homes were set ablaze, all for asserting their rights after the Civil War. Just blocks from where blood was shed in the fight for dignity, equality, and the fundamental right to be heard. People marched on these streets. People were beaten on these streets. People died on these streets— because they believed every American deserves equal representation under the law. And now, generations later, Donald Trump, Bill Lee, and Marsha Blackburn want to drag us backwards. It’s that simple. They are openly attempting to weaken voting rights and dilute political power in communities they don’t like. First, it’s schemes like the SAVE Act that could make it harder for millions of Americans—especially married women whose names may not match their birth certificates—to vote. Now, they want to redraw Tennessee’s maps again to strip Memphis of representation. Let’s call this what it is: a power grab. An attempt to silence voters in one of the largest Black communities in the South because they don’t like how we vote. Republicans may try to steal your voice, but they cannot steal your power unless you surrender it. We will never surrender it. | | They are trying to rig the game because they are terrified of the people. Just hours after the Supreme Court opened the door even wider for partisan gerrymandering, Marsha Blackburn and her allies started pushing to reconvene the legislature for one reason and one reason only: To carve up Memphis. To dilute our voice. To make sure some Tennesseans count less than others. They may try to package this as “good for Memphis.” Don’t buy it. What’s good for Memphis is when every voter is heard. What’s good for Memphis is fair representation. What’s good for Memphis is democracy—not politicians choosing their voters behind closed doors. Because if your ideas are strong, you shouldn’t need to rig the maps to win. But their policies are failing working people. Their agenda is unpopular. And instead of changing course, they’re trying to change the rules. They want to choose their voters instead of letting voters choose them. But here’s what they still don’t understand about Tennessee: You cannot gerrymander courage. You cannot redraw conviction. And you cannot erase the power of people who are organized and determined to fight back. And here’s what Marsha Blackburn should be worried about: You can gerrymander a congressional district. You cannot gerrymander a statewide election. ** You cannot redraw the borders of Tennessee. In a governor’s race, every vote matters the same—whether it comes from Memphis, Chattanooga, Nashville, Knoxville, or a small town that politicians only visit during election years. So if they want to make this election about power, we’ll make it about people. If they want fear, we’ll answer with organization. If they want division, we’ll answer with turnout. And we will build something too big to rig. | = Jerri Green Democratic Candidate for Governor Green For Governor POB 40049 Memphis, TN 38174 United States mailto:team@greenforgovernor.com | Paid for by Green for Governor. **They Knew: Big Tech, Roblox, and the Failure to Protect Children**
_By Wendy M. Yurgo_
We **[now know what the 764 network is and how these predators operate,](https://substack.com/redirect/b2c66b08-cd49-403b-8ab0-1113040d1446?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** who they target, and how quickly a child can be pulled into something they do not understand and cannot control. What once may have taken weeks now happens in hours, sometimes faster than a parent can recognize something is wrong.
That reality forces a question that cannot be avoided.
Who allowed this to happen?
These predators are not operating in isolation or in some hidden corner of the internet that is difficult to reach. They are operating inside platforms that millions of children use every day, communicating through systems built, maintained, and monetized by some of the **[largest technology companies](https://substack.com/redirect/a1b69a9d-9e19-4b78-8362-918bf1f356d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in the world. Those companies did not stumble into this problem overnight. They have **[known for years that children are being targeted](https://substack.com/redirect/02d7900e-2849-4870-bfde-2ef47dd7a2ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** inside these environments, and yet the exposure continues.
This is not new, it is not hidden, and it is not accidental.

* * *
* * *
"It is unconscionable that Roblox has allowed pedophiles to operate all across its platform and take advantage of our children. It's not only unbelievably immoral that the company is putting profits ahead of the protection of kids and lying to parents, but it's also illegal. That's why I've taken aggressive legal action against the company and will continue to fight any Big Tech corporation that wants to endanger our children and mislead parents."
There is no ambiguity in that statement. This is the Attorney General of Texas alleging that a platform trusted by millions of parents failed to protect children and misled the public about the risks. That distinction matters because it moves this issue out of the realm of awareness and directly into accountability.
Texas is not alone. Attorneys general across the country are taking action against Roblox, including lawsuits in Florida, Louisiana, Kentucky, Iowa, and Nebraska, along with investigations and enforcement actions in Georgia, Nevada, Alabama, and West Virginia. This is not a single dispute. It is a growing, multi-state response to the same underlying failure, and it reflects a broader recognition that what we are seeing is not a series of isolated incidents, but a structural problem that has been allowed to persist.
Roblox is not a small or niche platform. It reaches an enormous audience of children every single day, with well over 100 million daily active users globally and a user base heavily concentrated among minors, including tens of millions of children under the age of 13. When something operates at that scale, failures do not remain contained. They multiply.

* * *
* * *
That is what makes this moment different.
Platforms like Roblox are not passive hosts. They are designed environments where children interact, communicate, and form relationships. Every element of those environments is intentional, from how users connect to how conversations happen and what safeguards are in place. When predators are able to operate consistently inside those systems, it is not simply because bad actors exist. It is because those systems allow them to.
Children are contacted through in game chats, private messages, and conversations that are quickly redirected off platform. Identities are fabricated with ease, trust is built quickly, and once that trust is established the pattern does not vary. It turns. What begins as connection becomes coercion, and what follows is fear, control, and exploitation.
None of this is unpredictable.
It is a known pattern, and when a known pattern continues without meaningful interruption it stops being a failure and becomes a decision.
Parents were told these platforms were safe. They were told there were protections in place, that moderation existed, that reporting tools would catch what needed to be caught. That is not what is happening in practice. What is happening in practice is that children are being exposed to anonymous communication at scale, with minimal friction and systems that can be navigated by people who understand exactly where the gaps are.
At the same time, the burden has quietly shifted.
Parents are expected to monitor everything, to see everything, to anticipate what they cannot fully access, all while operating inside systems they did not design and cannot fully see. They are being asked to manage risk that originates somewhere else entirely, while the platforms themselves continue to benefit from the very engagement that creates that risk.
That is not a sustainable model, and it is not an honest one.
This is not an argument against technology or innovation. It is an argument against pretending that environments built for children can function safely without making child protection the foundation rather than an afterthought. Right now, that foundation does not exist in the way parents have been led to believe.
That is why attorneys general are stepping in. That is why litigation is moving forward. And that is why this issue is not going away.
Parents need to understand something clearly.
You are not overreacting, and you are not paranoid. You are responding to a system that has already shown it cannot fully protect your child, and until that changes, responsibility does not disappear. It returns to where it has always belonged.
Inside the home.

Folks,
The MAGA justices on John Roberts' Supreme Court just made it easier for opponents of voting rights to rig our elections — and not for the first time.
In their latest decision, these billionaire-backed justices gutted a key part of the Voting Rights Act, making it easier for state legislatures to draw up district maps that dilute the voting power of Black and brown communities. This is how they help politicians control election results before votes are even cast.
This is not normal. This is power being taken from us. For years, John Roberts and his fellow conservative justices have chipped away at voting rights, siding with billionaire interests and politicians who don’t want to compete for our votes. Now they’ve gone further — clearing the way for maps that decide who wins before Election Day .
Send a letter to Congress: Restore the Voting Rights Act and protect our votes >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/maga-justices-just-gutted-voting-rights-tell-congress-to-restore-them-now/?source=direct_link&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]

Across the country, people are already facing real barriers — being wrongly purged from voter rolls, waiting in hours-long lines after polling places are shut down, or being blocked from voting by restrictive rules. Now, even when we fight through those obstacles and cast our ballots, politicians can redraw the map to cancel out our votes.
That’s the plan: take our votes, twist the maps, and control the outcome.
But we can fight back. When we organize, speak out, and demand action together, we can force change . Send your letter now and join the growing movement demanding Congress restore voting rights protections.

Volunteer Round-Up

Montgomery County Meet and Greet
TOMORROW Saturday, May 2nd, 3 PM - 5 PM
You are invited to an intimate Meet and Greet with Congresswoman April McClain Delaney and Montgomery County Council Members Dawn Luedtke, Marilyn Balcombe, and Kate Stewart.
Join us for an evening of meaningful conversation with the women who are working every day to strengthen our communities, deliver results for Maryland families, and build a future we can all be proud of.
Hosted graciously by JaLynn Prince, this is a rare opportunity to connect directly with your elected representatives in a comfortable, personal setting.
Sign Up Here [https://www.mobilize.us/aprilmcclaindelaneyforcongress/event/938012/]
Door Knocking
TOMORROW Saturday, May 2nd, 10 AM - 12 PM
Before you head to the Meet and Greet, help knock doors around Gaithersburg! We'll be heading out to engage with voters, share the positive work happening in our district, and get people excited to re-elect Congresswoman April McClain Delaney.
Whether you have canvassed 1000 times or 0 times, this is a great chance to get involved with the campaign! We will begin with a quick training session before heading out, and go out in pairs; no experience is necessary!
Bring comfortable shoes, water, and whatever attire the weather dictates! It'll be a great day of conversation and community as we work towards re-electing Congresswoman Delaney. We can't wait to see you there!
Sign Up Here [https://www.mobilize.us/aprilmcclaindelaneyforcongress/event/941157/]
(Virtual) Phone Banks
Thursday Night Phone Banks Sign Up [https://www.mobilize.us/aprilmcclaindelaneyforcongress/event/934939/]
Every Thursday night, 6-8 PM , until Election Night, we will have a virtual and in-person phone bank to turn out supporters and recruit more volunteers!
Either come on into the office or join from the comfort of your own home .
All you need is a phone and the willingness to make some calls. Hope to see you there!
Tuesday Night Phone Banks Sign Up [https://www.mobilize.us/aprilmcclaindelaneyforcongress/event/936896/]
Every Tuesday night, 6-8 PM, until Election Night, we will have a virtual phone bank, with an in-person option in Frederick coming soon. Help turn out supporters and grow our volunteer base!
Join from the comfort of your own home.
Gaithersburg Office Volunteering
Tuesday - Friday, 10 AM - 6 PM, Every Week
Join us at the campaign office to help re-elect Congresswoman April McClain Delaney! Our office is open Tuesday - Friday from 10 AM to 6 PM, and volunteers can jump in however they’d like—whether that’s knocking doors, making phone calls, or helping with important office projects that keep the campaign running.
You’re welcome to pop in for an hour or stay longer, whatever fits your schedule. We just ask that you sign up ahead of time so we can make sure we have materials, lists, and snacks ready for you. It’s a great way to meet fellow supporters, build community, and make a real impact in the campaign .
Sign Up Here [https://www.mobilize.us/aprilmcclaindelaneyforcongress/event/942348/]
Donations
Help Power This Campaign Donation Photo [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/109172/images/4.14.24%20newsletter/IMG_9151%202%20%283%29.jpg]
We need your support to re-elect April to Congress! Any donation makes a world of difference.
Chip in Today [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/delaney-website?refcode=main-donate-link]
Best Regards, [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/109172/images/IMG_0045.jpeg]
Gus Schmoll

| | | Dear Friend,

Today is the deadline.

At midnight tonight, our May 1st fundraising deadline closes, and we’re still working to reach our goal. If you’ve been considering supporting our campaign, now is the moment to act:

[DONATE NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/Lf8vzRDfYmD?e=c0babbc643&c2id=bfcaacdd1ef4033edfed3d4b1d472a02)

This deadline is critical to ensuring we have the resources to communicate our message and reach voters before the election.

As a proud fourth-generation San Mateo County resident with over 20 years of public service, I’m running for Assessor-County Clerk-Recorder and Chief Elections Officer to modernize this office and restore confidence in how it serves our community. A prior review made it clear that stronger leadership, greater transparency, and improved trust are needed, and I’m ready to deliver.

As a former Mayor and current member of the Board of Supervisors, I oversee a $5.5 billion organization with 5,800 employees and strong financial reserves. I understand that accountability, sound management, and collaboration are essential to delivering reliable public services.

As your Chief Elections Officer, I will ensure elections are secure, efficient, and accessible to all eligible voters, while strengthening transparency and public trust.

We’re in the final hours, and every contribution today makes a real difference in helping us reach more voters before Election Day.
Please don’t wait, contribute before midnight tonight:

name: ARI
subject: What happens when AI is too dangerous to deploy?
body:
| | Americans for Responsible Innovation
# The ARI Briefing
April 2026 | [ ](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=a91d709b5e&e=a07d75591f)
---|---
Friends, This month, Anthropic released its latest model, Claude Mythos, and [concluded](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=a5dec61e45&e=a07d75591f) that it was too dangerous to deploy publicly. Mythos demonstrated the ability to find and exploit zero-day vulnerabilities in major software infrastructure, including decades-old bugs that had escaped extensive review. Within days of its launch, senior federal financial officials [convened](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=d3b0370d0a&e=a07d75591f) with major U.S. bank CEOs to discuss the cybersecurity implications. Anthropic withheld the model and stood up [Project Glasswing](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=7bea7bd8bb&e=a07d75591f), a joint effort with AWS, Apple, Microsoft, Google, and Cisco, to patch vulnerabilities in some of the world's most critical software infrastructure. And while the project may be a good sign for preventing cybersecurity incidents from the release of Mythos, here's the catch: **pre-release risk mitigation efforts like these are entirely voluntary**. Nothing in today's AI governance landscape would compel the next developer who reaches a comparable capability threshold to exercise the same restraint.
[ ](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=1e4d038c33&e=a07d75591f)
In a [new policy byte](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=55f911d379&e=a07d75591f), ARI lays out what frontier AI governance has to look like as genuinely dangerous capabilities arrive: independent pre-deployment oversight, third-party assurance, and structured safety cases adapted from aviation and energy regulation. The building blocks exist but what's missing is the urgency to assemble them. [Read After Mythos ->](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=88cfdbbe03&e=a07d75591f)
| 🔒 Chip Security
## Closing Vulnerable Security Loopholes
---
The Mythos moment calls attention to another critical conversation: keeping frontier AI capabilities out of the hands of adversaries by limiting access to compute. ARI [applauded](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=bb6a52eca6&e=a07d75591f) the House Foreign Affairs Committee for advancing the [MATCH Act](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=9597ee822a&e=a07d75591f) and the [Stop Stealing Our Chips Act](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=7f178f0a6a&e=a07d75591f), two ARI-endorsed bills that would restrict adversaries' access to advanced microchips and the manufacturing equipment needed to produce them. ARI President Brad Carson called the vote "an important step toward closing dangerous gaps in the United States' export control system." [Read ARI's Full Statement ->](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=ed2625798c&e=a07d75591f)
[ ](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=783d2de03b&e=a07d75591f)
The same week, ARI sent a [letter](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=850b874479&e=a07d75591f) to OSTP Director Michael Kratsios applauding his [recent memo](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=6ad6f4a902&e=a07d75591f) on adversarial distillation by Chinese AI developers and pushing the case further. API security and legal accountability are necessary but insufficient without restricting the export of the advanced AI chips that make distillation operationally viable at scale. [Read the Kratsios Letter ->](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=247cd46836&e=a07d75591f)
🌐 Event Recap
## Faith Leaders Bring Moral Voice to AI Policy
Earlier this month, ARI convened faith leaders from across traditions for our Faith & AI lunch-and-learn panel on the Hill, asking practical and moral questions: what does human dignity mean in an age of intelligent machines, and what role should faith communities play in shaping the rules? The panel drew an engaged audience for a discussion that ranged from the moral weight of life-and-death decisions to the responsibilities of developers and policymakers to communities whose values are too often left out of AI debates. This conversation was preceded by a [coalition letter](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=640001c369&e=a07d75591f) from faith leaders calling for a clear "human-in-the-loop" requirement for AI-enabled autonomous weapons. The signers' message is direct: technology advances faster than our moral frameworks, and the window for courage and conviction is narrow. [Read the Letter ->](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=bc27dbe770&e=a07d75591f)
📚 Also This Month
## New from the Policy Team
[The New Iron Triangle.](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=22edc1dd2a&e=a07d75591f) AI is rewriting the Pentagon's classic speed-cost-capability tradeoff, and reliability is the variable being sacrificed. [Wargaming Needs AI. The Department of War Isn't Ready.](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=5282c37d7e&e=a07d75591f) The case for a Crisis Simulation Center of Excellence with Secretary-level authority to drag wargaming out of its analog past. [The Recent Legal Victories Against Big Tech Are Promising, But Not Enough to Protect Kids.](https://ari.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=3de8883ed9&e=a07d75591f) Why the Meta verdicts matter, and why a statutory duty of care is still the safeguard minors need.
From the courts to Capitol Hill to the pulpit, the conversations shaping AI policy this month made one thing clear: the public is ready for guardrails, and the moral, legal, and strategic stakes are converging fast. Thank you for staying with us, for reading, signing, sharing, and showing up. Your engagement is what gives our work weight. Onward, The ARI Team

Nothing in today's AI governance landscape would compel the next developer who reaches a comparable capability threshold to exercise the same restraint. In a , ARI lays out what frontier AI governance has to look like as genuinely dangerous capabilities arrive: independent pre-deployment oversight, third-party assurance, and structured safety cases adapted from aviation and energy regulation. The building blocks exist but what's missing is the urgency to assemble them. | 🔒 Chip Security Closing Vulnerable Security Loopholes The Mythos moment calls attention to another critical conversation: keeping frontier AI capabilities out of the hands of adversaries by limiting access to compute. ARI the House Foreign Affairs Committee for advancing the and the , two ARI-endorsed bills that would restrict adversaries' access to advanced microchips and the manufacturing equipment needed to produce them. ARI President Brad Carson called the vote "an important step toward closing dangerous gaps in the United States' export control system." The same week, ARI sent a to OSTP Director Michael Kratsios applauding his on adversarial distillation by Chinese AI developers and pushing the case further. API security and legal accountability are necessary but insufficient without restricting the export of the advanced AI chips that make distillation operationally viable at scale. 🌐 Event Recap Faith Leaders Bring Moral Voice to AI Policy Earlier this month, ARI convened faith leaders from across traditions for our Faith & AI lunch-and-learn panel on the Hill, asking practical and moral questions: what does human dignity mean in an age of intelligent machines, and what role should faith communities play in shaping the rules? The panel drew an engaged audience for a discussion that ranged from the moral weight of life-and-death decisions to the responsibilities of developers and policymakers to communities whose values are too often left out of AI debates. This conversation was preceded by a from faith leaders calling for a clear "human-in-the-loop" requirement for AI-enabled autonomous weapons. The signers' message is direct: technology advances faster than our moral frameworks, and the window for courage and conviction is narrow. 📚 Also This Month New from the Policy Team AI is rewriting the Pentagon's classic speed-cost-capability tradeoff, and reliability is the variable being sacrificed. The case for a Crisis Simulation Center of Excellence with Secretary-level authority to drag wargaming out of its analog past. Why the Meta verdicts matter, and why a statutory duty of care is still the safeguard minors need. From the courts to Capitol Hill to the pulpit, the conversations shaping AI policy this month made one thing clear: the public is ready for guardrails, and the moral, legal, and strategic stakes are converging fast. Thank you for staying with us, for reading, signing, sharing, and showing up. Your engagement is what gives our work weight. subject: Are Our Leaders Focused on What Actually Matters?

body:
If you ask most Americans what is on their mind right now, the answer is simple: affordability. The cost of everyday life, from groceries and gas to housing and healthcare, has become the defining issue for families across the country.

| | | [ ](www.forwardparty.com)
---
### Peter —
If you ask most Americans what is on their mind right now, the answer is simple: affordability. The cost of everyday life, from groceries and gas to housing and healthcare, has become the defining issue for families across the country. Inflation may have cooled from its peak, but prices are still significantly higher than they were just a few years ago. Home prices remain near record highs, putting ownership out of reach for many, while rent continues to strain household budgets. According to Gallup, inflation and the cost of living consistently rank among the top concerns for Americans, with a majority saying they are worried about their personal financial situation. Data from Pew Research Center shows similar trends, with many Americans saying their incomes are not keeping up with rising costs. At the same time, confidence in leadership is near historic lows. Congressional approval is around 10 percent in recent Gallup tracking, President Trump’s approval rating has dropped to 34 percent, and trust in government more broadly remains deeply eroded. Yet despite that dissatisfaction, incumbents continue to win reelection at rates exceeding 90 percent. That disconnect tells you something important. The system is not responding to what people are actually experiencing. While affordability tops the list of concerns, Washington often appears focused elsewhere. That includes partisan maneuvering like gerrymandering, political investigations and prosecutions, and internal power struggles that have little to do with lowering costs or improving economic opportunity. The results speak for themselves. Congress has passed relatively few major pieces of legislation that directly address the core drivers of affordability. Conversations about long term economic challenges, like preparing workers for technological change, strengthening local economies, and expanding access to good paying jobs, are not getting the attention they deserve. Meanwhile, approval ratings for both Congress and national leadership remain deeply underwater, reinforcing the sense that the system is not delivering. This is exactly why the Forward Party is focused on building something different. We are recruiting and supporting candidates who are solutions focused, grounded in their communities, and committed to listening to what voters are actually saying. That means using data, evidence, and real world experience to shape policy, not ideology or party talking points. It means prioritizing affordability, economic opportunity, and long term stability over short term political wins. There is a better path forward, and more Americans are starting to see it. Across the country, people are stepping up to run for office, engage in their communities, and demand a system that actually reflects their lives and priorities. Change will not happen overnight, but it is already beginning. With leaders who are willing to listen, focus on real problems, and work toward practical solutions, we can build a system that delivers again. One that makes life more affordable, expands opportunity, and gives people confidence in their future. **Please forward this to your friends, family, and coworkers. It helps us introduce them to Forward and to what we are building. Also consider inviting them to one of our upcoming events listed below. We'd love to meet them.**

Episode 8 - Lindsey Drath and Lieutenant Governor Kerry Healey are joined by Forward National Communications Director John Goodwin for a thoughtful conversation on the growing momentum behind independent voters and what it really takes to challenge America’s entrenched two-party system. What starts as a discussion on political identity quickly expands into a deeper look at structural barriers, voter frustration, and the untapped potential sitting in plain sight across the country. At the center of the conversation is a striking reality: nearly half of Americans now identify as independents, yet the system itself makes it incredibly difficult for those voices to translate into representation. From closed primaries to limited ballot access, the episode breaks down how the current structure favors party insiders while leaving everyday voters on the outside. We hope you enjoy!
